data.title: Launch HN: MindFort (YC X25) – AI agents for continuous pentesting
data.author: bveiseh
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕MindFort产品的功能、使用场景、安全性及与竞品差异的讨论。

不同观点：
• [功能质疑与技术细节] Sohcahtoa82提到MindFort是否能处理现代web应用中DAST工具常见的问题，如API数据获取、DOM更新、非 cookie的session token等。他质疑MindFort是否能有效应对XSS false positives和非传统session管理。
• [产品使用场景] robszumski询问产品的具体使用方式，例如是否是针对公开可用的web应用，或者是否可以在本地开发环境运行，甚至是否需要自托管。
• [性能与扩展性] mparis对MindFort如何处理1到10万页的web应用提出疑问，关注其扩展性以及是否会影响其他用户的体验。他还担心检测到漏洞后系统是否会进行危险的操作。
• [安全与隔离] sumanyusharma关心MindFort如何验证漏洞、如何隔离和加密客户代码和数据，以及是否会自动应用补丁或需要人工审核。他还询问了与CI/CD工作流的整合情况。
• [法律与道德] blibble关注MindFort如何确保对目标网站的测试是经过同意的，即如何控制测试的合法性。
• [竞品比较] gyanchawdhary询问MindFort与xbow.com、shinobi.security等其他安全产品有何不同，关注其独特卖点。
• [技术原理] lazyninja987对MindFort的代理是否需要访问源代码以生成攻击策略表示关注，尤其是对黑盒测试的处理方式，以及漏洞列表是否基于公开披露的漏洞信息生成。

补充讨论：
• [价格相关] handfuloflight询问了产品的定价方案，这是用户关心的实际使用成本问题。
• [幽默与调侃] HocusLocus用幽默的方式表达了对渗透测试工具潜在风险的担忧，虽然未提出具体问题但反映了对工具安全性的关注。

争议焦点：
• MindFort是否能够有效处理现代web应用中的复杂情况（如API、非传统session管理等）以及如何确保测试的合法性和安全性，是讨论的主要争议点。用户对产品的技术能力和使用限制提出了较多疑问。

data.title: Deepseek R1-0528
data.author: error404x
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了DeepSeek-R1-0528模型的基本信息。该模型拥有6850亿参数，支持多种张量类型，包括BF16、F8_E4M3和F32。目前，该模型尚未被任何推理提供商部署，且最近一次更新是在33分钟前。模型相关文件包括1个微调版本和包含该模型的9个项目的集合。用户可以请求提供商支持以部署此模型。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：DeepSeek R1 模型的发布及其影响

不同观点：
• [正面评价与期待]
  - [jacob019] 认为DeepSeek R1的性能与OpenAI的模型相当，而且是开源的，具有完全开放的推理标记，期待更多信息。
  - [willchen] 赞赏Deepseek的低调更新，带来了显著的改进。
  - [deepsquirrelnet] 认为国际间的技术竞争对社会有益，反对美国公司通过并购消除竞争的做法。

• [技术优化与实用性]
  - [danielhanchen] 提供了1 bit动态量化的版本，将模型大小从713GB压缩到185GB，并提供了使用CPU内存的技巧。
  - [mjcohen] 提到Deepseek可以在较旧的设备上运行，如iPod Touch。

• [硬件需求与可行性]
  - [transcriptase] 对普通用户如何使用该模型表示好奇，尤其是硬件需求，担心需要复杂的技术手段。
  - [AJAlabs] 和 [htrp] 指出671B参数的模型对本地运行来说过于庞大，可能需要高性能硬件如8个h100 80s。

• [市场与价格讨论]
  - [cesarvarela] 认为DeepSeek R1的价格相对较低，性能也不错，且多数供应商提供量化版本。

补充讨论：
• [缺乏信息与期待测试]
  - [acheong08] 指出目前关于该模型的信息较少，希望尽快看到基准测试。
  - [jacob019] 也提到缺乏模型卡和发布说明，对模型的具体改进和上下文窗口信息表示关注。

• [应用场景与灵感]
  - [karencarits] 询问本地LLM的实际应用案例，表示自己在实验中难以找到有用的应用灵感。

• [特定技术实现期待]
  - [canergly] 表示希望尽快在Groq上看到DeepSeek R1的实现。

争议焦点：
• 主要集中在模型的硬件需求和普通用户的使用可行性上。一方面，技术爱好者对模型的优化和压缩表示赞赏，另一方面，普通用户担心模型对高性能硬件的依赖。

data.title: Visualize and debug Rust programs with a new lens
data.author: alex_hirner
data.article_summary: Terres是一只寄居蟹，隶属于Rustacean家族，是Ferris的伙伴及官方吉祥物。作为Rust编程语言社区的象征，Terres与Ferris一起代表该社区的友好和包容精神，旨在通过可爱的形象吸引更多开发者加入并参与Rust编程语言的发展。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Rust编程语言及其相关工具的应用和潜力，特别是调试工具和可视化工具。

不同观点：
• **支持Rust工具的潜力**：[leoh]认为Rust体现了“简单的事情应该简单，复杂的事情应该可能”的理念，并预测Rust将在未来几年得到更广泛的应用。[Rust-Trends]也表示了对Rust项目的赞赏，并计划在新闻通讯中进行推荐。

• **工具的实用性质疑**：[forrestthewoods]对该工具在实际程序调试中的有效性表示怀疑，认为玩具例子不能展示其在真实场景中的价值。

• **工具的比较和替代**：[spencerflem]将该工具与Glamorous Toolkit进行比较，表示对这类解释程序运行过程的工具非常感兴趣。[quotemstr]则从调试器的角度指出，Rust在调试方面与其他原生代码语言并无本质区别，认为专门为Rust设计的调试工具并无特别必要。

• **工具的功能和可用性问题**：[waschl]提到该工具无法与其在qemu中运行的Rust OS内核一起使用。[levkk]表示希望使用该工具，但遇到脚本需要sudo权限和不使用VSCode的问题。[dochtman]则关注该工具是否能在macOS上运行，并对移动端浏览体验提出质疑。

• **工具的技术比较**：[Veserv]将该工具与chrome://tracing进行比较，认为其在轨迹可视化和执行时间信息展示方面不如后者密集和有意义。

补充讨论：
• **工具的具体应用场景**：[tonyhart7]表示希望将该工具应用于数据库调试，询问具体工具名称。[orsenthil]则提到该工具让他想起了Pythontutor，并对其用户界面表示赞赏。

争议焦点：
• **工具的实际应用价值**：部分用户如[forrestthewoods]对其在真实程序调试中的有效性持怀疑态度，而其他用户如[leoh]和[Rust-Trends]则对其未来应用前景持乐观态度。

• **工具的比较和选择**：用户对不同调试和可视化工具如Glamorous Toolkit、chrome://tracing等的功能和优劣进行了比较和讨论。

data.title: A Visual History of Chessmen
data.author: alberto-m
data.article_summary: 这篇文章简要介绍了国际象棋棋子设计的历史演变。象棋的祖先可以追溯到公元前2500年印度河流域的文明，当时可能使用粘土小雕像作为早期棋子。到公元7世纪，印度出现了一种叫“恰图兰卡”的游戏，具有四种不同的棋子类型，这些类型后来演变为现代象棋的棋子。恰图兰卡传到波斯，发展为“沙特兰兹”，并逐渐演变为现代象棋。在沙特兰兹时期，棋子开始变得抽象，但也有具象的例子。文章还提到象棋在中世纪的传播和演变，包括在不同国家和时期的设计变化。20世纪后，棋子设计继续发展，进入了多样化的现代时期。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：国际象棋棋子的选择与设计演变

不同观点：
• [tzs] 认为，对于半职业或职业棋手来说，历史复古或主题棋盘（如《爱丽丝梦游仙境》、美国内战、福尔摩斯等主题）并不适合作为礼物。这些棋手更倾向于使用符合FIDE或本地棋联比赛标准的棋具，实用性重于艺术性。此外，即使棋手自己愿意使用主题棋盘，也可能很难找到愿意一起使用这种棋盘的对手。
• [iamwil] 对3D打印棋盘感兴趣，并提到自己曾用OpenSCAD设计过一个棋盘，关注技术实现和设计。
• [Daisywh] 表达了对传统简陋塑料棋盘的情感，认为尽管现在有许多精致的棋盘，但最初学习的简陋棋盘仍然是最先想到的“真正的”棋盘。
• [keyle] 赞赏文章的详尽和历史棋具设计的演变，尤其是对文章中的历史细节印象深刻。
• [ggm] 分享了关于北欧棋子的个人故事和历史背景，提到其母亲曾说盾牌上的咬痕图案是北欧战士在战前自我激励的方式，并讨论了北欧棋子的历史分布和博物馆收藏情况。

补充讨论：
• [rubit_xxx16] 指出文章中遗漏了一些重要内容，如路易威登设计和超级马里奥主题棋盘，并提到文章对战时旅行棋盘的描述过于局限，还应包括其他国家和风格的棋具演变。
• [arh68] 提到自己更习惯于2D电脑棋盘，特别是“USCF风格”的棋盘，并表示难以适应新的棋盘设计。
• [somishere] 表达了对Lanier Graham设计棋盘的偏好，认为其设计不需要车床或凿子，较为简洁。
• [zabzonk] 分享了个人经历，前妻曾制作了一套北欧风格的棋盘，虽然不错，但仍认为Staunton设计最好。
• [abetaha] 对Staunton棋盘设计由他人设计感到惊讶，并对文章中丰富的棋盘设计感到赞叹。
• [paulddraper] 讨论了“将杀”规则的复杂性，认为如果国王可以被捕获，虽然会简化规则，但会失去诸如和棋等策略性元素。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于主题棋盘的实用性与艺术性之争。一方认为主题棋盘更多是艺术品，不适合实际比赛使用；另一方则可能认为主题棋盘有其独特魅力和收藏价值。

Chaturanga, chess ancestor
By the 7th Century CE, people in India were playing
chaturanga
("four divisions"). The name refers to four types of solider that made up the game—infantry, cavalry, elephants, and chariots, commanded by a raja—that were modeled on the armies of the time. It was the innovation of these different piece types, which each moved in different ways, that distinguished
chaturanga
from other war games. The different piece types are the ancestors of the pieces of the modern game, and one of the reasons why we can trace chess back to
chaturanga
.
Chaturagna
spread outwards from India and is thought to be the common ancestor of many similar games. When it reaches Persia in the 8th Century, the game becomes
shatranj
, which would later reach Europe and develop into modern chess.
A map showing the spread of
chaturanga
and its influence on other games around the globe, including
shatranj
, chess,
xiàngqí
(China) and
shogi
(Japan).
If you were transported to ancient India, you would not necessarily recognise the game they were playing as chess. One of the earliest descriptions we have of how
chaturanga
was played comes from the 11th Century Persian scholar Al-Biruni's text,
India
. Like modern chesss,
chaturanga
was played on an eight by eight grid, which had been borrowed from an existing Indian game called
ashtapada
. In the
chaturanga
Al-Biruni describes, however, this board was the battleground for
four
players and four different armies at once. It was also a game of chance (!), where players rolled dice to decide which pieces to move.
Both modern chess players and 11th Century Persian
shatranj
players would find the moves of this game to be different. Al-Biruni descirbes the elephant (the ancient bishop) as able to move only one square diagonally at a time, or one square forward instead. ("They say that these five squares (i.e. the one straight forward and the others at the corners) are the places occupied by the trunk and the four feet of the elephant.")
If
shatranj
to the West and
xiàngqí
to the East, both games for two players, descend from the same game, it would make sense to assume that the common ancestor was also a two player board game. Chess historian
H J R Murray, who wrote the definitive treatise of the origins of chess, thought,
from the way Persian and Arabics writers described
chaturanga
in reference to
shatranj
, that there must have been two-player versions of the game in India at the same time as Al-Biruni witnessed the four-player game. Murray cannot say which, two- or four-player
chaturanga
, he believes came first. However, in is certain that there were two-player Indian chess games in later centuries. These, which have dispensed with dice, were called by some variation of
buddhidyūta
, "intellectual game".
8th C.
Afrasiab
In the Second Persian Empire,
chaturanga
becomes
shatranj
. As
shatranj
, new rules are introduced that cause the game to begin to resemble modern chess, including the rule that the King cannot be captured but must be rendered helpless: shah mat, the King is helpless, gives us the word checkmate.
The earliest
shatranj
pieces were figural (depicting recognisble forms from life), like those discovered in
Afrasiab
, modern Uzbekistan, made from ivory and dating from the 700s. They feature soldiers on foot, horseback or riding chariots or elephants.
The Afrasiab chessmen are normally considered the oldest definitive chessmen. While there followed a shift in favour of abstract pieces, they must not have been completely replaced, as later examples of Islamic figurative pieces have been found.
Seven figurative chessmen were excavated in
Afrasiab
, northern Samarkland.
Early figural chessmen
, Left: a bishop (elephant), date given as 7th (!?) to 8th C. Right: rook (chariot) 11th to 12th C.
8th C.
Abstract Persian
The shift to abstract chessmen has traditionally been attributed to religious an-iconism: the prohibition of figurative objects to prevent idolatry. However, not only have later figural pieces been found, but per the Met, abstract Persian chessmen are now thought to predate the Islamic conquest. Perhaps the adoption of symbolic chessmen were to make them easier to distinguish in games, or cheaper to manufacture?

44087898.article_summary: 这篇文章简要介绍了国际象棋棋子设计的历史演变。象棋的祖先可以追溯到公元前2500年印度河流域的文明，当时可能使用粘土小雕像作为早期棋子。到公元7世纪，印度出现了一种叫“恰图兰卡”的游戏，具有四种不同的棋子类型，这些类型后来演变为现代象棋的棋子。恰图兰卡传到波斯，发展为“沙特兰兹”，并逐渐演变为现代象棋。在沙特兰兹时期，棋子开始变得抽象，但也有具象的例子。文章还提到象棋在中世纪的传播和演变，包括在不同国家和时期的设计变化。20世纪后，棋子设计继续发展，进入了多样化的现代时期。

data.author: coolelectronics
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了将游戏《Terraria》和《Celeste》移植到WebAssembly并在浏览器中运行的过程。作者受一些在浏览器中运行的奇怪项目启发，决定尝试将这两款C#编写并基于FNA引擎的游戏移植到WebAssembly。通过反编译游戏、提取嵌入的动态链接库、配置项目文件和解决FNA引擎的本地组件问题，作者成功将《Celeste》和《Terraria》移植到WebAssembly，并能在浏览器中运行。整个过程涉及处理字节码、修复运行时错误和配置复杂的构建系统，最终实现了这两款游戏在浏览器中的运行。

44101175.article_content:
Porting Terraria and Celeste to WebAssembly
(tldr: terraria in the browser
here
, celeste in the
browser
here
.
terraria git
repository
,
celeste git
repository
)
One of my favorite genres of weird project is "thing running
in the browser that should absolutely not be running in the browser".
Some of my favorites are the
Half Life 1 port
that uses a reimplementation of goldsrc, the
direct recompilation of Minecraft
1.12
from java bytecode to WebAssembly, and even an
emulated Pentium 4 capable of running modern
linux
.
In early 2024 I came across an old post of someone running a half
working copy of the game
Celeste
entirely in the browser.
When I saw that they had never posted their work publicly, I became
about as obsessed with the idea as you would expect, leading to a year
long journey of bytecode hacks, runtime bugs, patch files, and horrible
build systems all to create something that really should have never
existed in the first place.
Strawberry Jam
mod running in celeste-wasm
Credits to
r58
for figuring
most of this stuff out with me and
bomberfish
for making the neat UI.
Terraria
I knew that both Celeste and Terraria were written in C# using the
FNA engine, so we should have been able to port Terraria in the same way
they did for Celeste, so we set that as a goal.
The original post didn't have too many details to go off of, but we
figured a good place to start was setting up a development environment
for modding. In theory, all we needed to do was decompile the game,
change the target to webassembly, and then recompile it.
It turns out that we were very lucky with the game being C#â since
the bytecode format (referred to as MSIL or just IL) maps very closely
to the original code, and the game was shipped with the .pdb symbol
database for mapping function names (and local variables!), we could get
decompilation output that was more or less identical to the original
code.
Setting up a project
Running
ilspycmd
on Terraria.exe, decompilation
failed
because of a missing
ReLogic.dll
. It turned
out that the library was actually embedded into the game itself as a
resource.
That's.. odd, but we can extract it from the binary pretty easily.
Easiest way is just to create a new c# project and dynamically load in
the assembly..
Assembly assembly
=
Assembly
.
LoadFile
(
"Terraria.exe"
);
And then since all the terraria code is loaded, we can just extract
it the same way the game does!
Stream
?
stream
=
assembly
.
GetManifestResourceStream
(
"Terraria.Libraries.NET.ReLogic.dll"
);
FileStream outstream
=
File
.
OpenWrite
(
"ReLogic.dll"
);
stream
.
CopyTo
(
outstream
);
After putting
ReLogic.dll
into the library path,
decompilation succeeded, and after installing all the dependencies
Terraria uses, the project recompiles and launches on linux. Now that we
knew the decompilation was good, I created a project file for the new
code targetting WASM and configuring emscripten.
<
Project
Sdk=
"Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly"
>
<
PropertyGroup
>
<
StartupObject
>Program</
StartupObject
>
<
EmccExtraLDFlags
>-sMIN_WEBGL_VERSION=2 -sWASMFS</
EmccExtraLDFlags
>
<
EmccEnvironment
>web,worker</
EmccEnvironment
>
</
PropertyGroup
>
<
ItemGroup
>
<
PackageReference
Include=
"Newtonsoft.Json"
Version=
"13.0.3"
/>
<
PackageReference
Include=
"Newtonsoft.Json.Bson"
Version=
"1.0.3"
/>
<
PackageReference
Include=
"DotNetZip"
Version=
"1.16.0"
/>
<
PackageReference
Include=
"MP3Sharp"
Version=
"1.0.5"
/>
<
PackageReference
Include=
"NVorbis"
Version=
"0.10.5"
/>
</
ItemGroup
>
</
Project
>
Somewhat surprisingly, all of the project code compiles without
issue, but the FNA engine is partially written in c++ and needs to be
linked against its native components. The web target isn't officially
supported by FNA, but its native components compile without issue under
emscripten's
opengl
emulation layer
. This process is automated by
FNA-WASM-BUILD
on
github actions to make things slightly less painful.
The archive files from the build system can be added with
<NativeFileReference>
and then will automatically get
linked together with the rest of the runtime during emscripten
compilation.
<!-- FNA -->
<
NativeFileReference
Include=
"SDL3.a"
/>
<
NativeFileReference
Include=
"FNA3D.a"
/>
<
NativeFileReference
Include=
"libmojoshader.a"
/>
<
NativeFileReference
Include=
"FAudio.a"
/>
After an eight minute compile step dotnet spit out the full
webassembly and JS bundle, which I almost couldn't believe at first,
since at this point we had just basically just pasted in the terraria
source and barely had to tweak anything. Now we just had to figure out
how to run the actual game.
Running the game
We ended up just gutting terraria's linux entry point and creating a
minimal Init() function tagged with
[JSExport]
so it was
callable, then writing a simple loop to drive the FNA game loop from
JS.

runtime
=
await
dotnet

create
()
;
const
config
=
runtime
.
getConfig
()
;
const
exports
=
await
runtime
.
getAssemblyExports

data.title: A visual exploration of vector embeddings
data.author: pamelafox
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了Pycon 2025海报中的向量嵌入模型，详细解释了不同模型的特点和应用。向量嵌入是将输入（如单词、词组或图像）映射为浮点数列表，代表该输入在多维空间中的位置。不同模型有不同的维度、输入类型和相似性空间。

1. **word2vec**：曾是最著名的嵌入模型，只接受单个单词，输出300维向量，擅长表达单词的语义。
2. **text-embedding-ada-002**：OpenAI发布的模型，快速且廉价，接受8192个标记，输出1536维向量。该模型在多个向量中出现奇特的下降尖峰。
3. **text-embedding-3-small**：2024年发布的新模型，更快更便宜，输出1536维向量，无尖峰现象，分布更均匀。

不同模型的相似性空间不同，比较向量时需使用距离度量标准（如余弦相似性）。word2vec和text-embedding-3-small模型在语义相似性上表现更直观，而text-embedding-ada-002的相似性值范围较窄，需调整预期。选择模型时，需确保其相似性排名与人判断的一致。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：向量嵌入的实用性、可视化及其在不同模型中的表现

不同观点：
• **godelski** 认为高维空间中的可视化和直觉会失效，高维空间中距离和角度的概念变得模糊，容易误导。他强调不应过度依赖可视化工具。

这些讨论揭示了在处理和理解向量嵌入时面临的实际挑战和不同方法的优劣。

44120306.article_content:
For Pycon 2025, I created a poster exploring vector embedding models, which you can
download at full-size
.
In this post, I'll translate that poster into words.
Vector embeddings
A
vector embedding
is a mapping from an input (like a word, list of words, or image) into a list of floating point numbers.
That list of numbers represents that input in the multidimensional embedding space of the model. We refer to the length of the list as its
dimensions
, so a list with 1024 numbers would have 1024 dimensions.
Embedding models
Each embedding model has its own dimension length, allowed input types, similarity space, and other characteristics.
word2vec
For a long time, word2vec was the most well-known embedding model. It could only accept single words, but it was easily trainable on any machine, it is very good at representing the semantic meaning of words. A typical word2vec model outputs vectors of 300 dimensions, though you can customize that during training. This chart shows the 300 dimensions for the word "queen" from a word2vec model that was trained on a Google News dataset:
text-embedding-ada-002
When OpenAI came out with its chat models, it also offered embedding models, like text-embedding-ada-002 which was
released in 2022
. That model was significant for being powerful, fast, and significantly cheaper than previous models, and is still used by many developers. The text-embedding-ada-002 model accepts up to 8192 "tokens", where a "token" is the unit of measurement for the model (typically corresponding to a word or syllable), and outputs 1536 dimensions. Here are the 1536 dimensions for the word "queen":
Notice the strange spike downward at dimension 196? I found that spike in every single vector embedding generated from the model - short ones, long ones, English ones, Spanish ones, etc. For whatever reason, this model always produces a vector with that spike. Very peculiar!
text-embedding-3-small
In 2024, OpenAI
announced two new embedding models
, text-embedding-3-small and text-embedding-3-large, which are once again faster and cheaper than the previous model. For this post, we'll use the text-embedding-3-small model as an example. Like the previous model, it accepts 8192 tokens, and outputs 1536 dimensions by default. As we'll see later, it optionally allows you to output less dimensions. Here are the 1536 dimensions for the word "queen":
This time, there is no downward spike, and all of the values look well distributed across the positive and negative.
Similarity spaces
Why go through all this effort to turn inputs into embeddings? Once we have embeddings of different inputs from the same embedding model, then we can compare the vectors using a distance metric, and determine the relative similarity of inputs. Each model has its own "similarity space", so the similarity rankings will vary across models (sometimes only slightly, sometimes significantly). When you're choosing a model, you want to make sure that its similarity rankings are well aligned with human rankings.
For example, let's compare the embedding for "dog" to the embeddings for 1000 common English words, across each of the models, using the cosine similarity metric.
word2vec similarity
For the word2vec model, here are the closest words to "dog", and the similarity distribution across all 1000 words:
As you can see, the cosine similarity values range from 0 to 0.76, with most values clustered between 0 and 0.2.
text-embedding-ada-002 similarity
For the text-embedding-ada-002 model, the closest words and similarity distribution is quite different:
Curiously, the model thinks that "god" is very similar to "dog". My theory is that OpenAI trained this model in a way that made it pay attention to spelling similarities, since that's the main way that "dog" and "god" are similar. Another curiousity is that the similarity values are in a very tight range, between 0.75 and 0.88. Many developers find that unintuitive, as we might see a value of 0.75 initially and think it indicates a very similar value, when it actually is the opposite for this model. That's why it's so important to look at
relative
similarity values, not absolute. Or, if you're going to look at absolute values, you must calibrate your expectations first based on the standard similarity range of each model.
text-embedding-3-small similarity
The text-embedding-3-small model looks more similar to word2vec in terms of its closest words and similarity distribution:
The most similar words are all similarity in semantics only, no spelling, and the similarity values peak at 0.68, with most values between 0.2 and 0.4. My theory is that OpenAI saw the weirdness in the text-embedding-ada-002 model and cleaned it up in the text-embedding-3 models.
Vector similarity metrics
There are multiple metrics we could possibly use to decide how "similar" two vectors are. We need to get a bit more math-y to understand the metrics, but I've found it helpful to know enough about metrics so that I can pi

本文介绍了Pycon 2025海报中的向量嵌入模型，详细解释了不同模型的特点和应用。向量嵌入是将输入（如单词、词组或图像）映射为浮点数列表，代表该输入在多维空间中的位置。不同模型有不同的维度、输入类型和相似性空间。

1. **word2vec**：曾是最著名的嵌入模型，只接受单个单词，输出300维向量，擅长表达单词的语义。
2. **text-embedding-ada-002**：OpenAI发布的模型，快速且廉价，接受8192个标记，输出1536维向量。该模型在多个向量中出现奇特的下降尖峰。
3. **text-embedding-3-small**：2024年发布的新模型，更快更便宜，输出1536维向量，无尖峰现象，分布更均匀。

不同模型的相似性空间不同，比较向量时需使用距离度量标准（如余弦相似性）。word2vec和text-embedding-3-small模型在语义相似性上表现更直观，而text-embedding-ada-002的相似性值范围较窄，需调整预期。选择模型时，需确保其相似性排名与人判断的一致。

data.title: Chimps strike stones against trees as communication, study suggests
data.author: pseudolus
data.article_summary: 一项由瓦赫宁根大学和德国灵长类研究中心进行的为期五年的野外研究发现，西非野生黑猩猩使用石头敲击树干，产生声音，作为一种沟通方式。研究团队在几内亚比绍自然保护区的五个地点通过摄像陷阱记录了这种行为，主要由成年雄性黑猩猩重复进行，导致树下堆积了石头。这种被称为“石头辅助击鼓”的行为与传统用手或脚击鼓不同，通常伴随着大声的呼喊，之后是沉默。研究者认为，这种行为可能用于远距离通信，且通过社会学习在群体中传递。该发现表明文化传承并非人类独有，对自然保护有重要意义。研究发表于《Biology Letters》期刊。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：动物智能与人类独特性、语言与沟通的本质

不同观点：
• jurgenaut23认为，动物比人类想象中更聪明是显而易见的，人类作为动物并没有什么特别的优越性。他反对“人类例外论”，认为这种观点在生物学和哲学上都不成立。
• jpease用幽默的方式描述了黑猩猩用石头敲击树木作为威胁信号，暗示这种行为可以视为一种原始的沟通方式。
• _elephant提出，语言可能始于共鸣而非词汇，黑猩猩扔石头可能是一种更深层次的沟通信号，而不仅仅是为了传递简单的信息。他们质疑人类对语言的狭义定义，并提出节奏、震动和共享注意力等非人类独有的沟通形式。
• HeyLaughingBoy提到Bjork早期的歌曲中已有类似的概念，暗示这种对动物智能和沟通的认识并非新观点。

补充讨论：
• kragen详细介绍了人类使用鼓等乐器进行远距离通信的历史和技术，并提供了相关文献和实例，强调这种通信方式在不同文化中的广泛应用和重要性。
• bilsbie提到随着时间推移，人们对动物智能的理解发生了变化，过去被认为不可能的复杂情感和行为现在已被广泛接受。
• rickydroll用幽默的方式引用了一句台词，强调沟通方式的多样性。
• CommenterPerson和Bas123分享了个人经历，展示了人类和动物在特定情境下的独特沟通方式。
• dedicate指出，人们过于关注 verbal language（口头语言），而忽视了其他形式的沟通。
• seethishat提到关于“大脚怪”的传闻，将其与黑猩猩的类似行为联系起来，带有一定的调侃意味。
• Caelus9认为每种动物都有其独特的沟通方式，只是人类尚未完全理解，并提到关于海豚声音的研究展示了动物沟通的复杂性。

争议焦点：
• 人类是否真的在智能和沟通上比其他动物更优越（“人类例外论”是否成立）。
• 语言的定义是否过于狭隘，是否应包括非人类动物的沟通方式。

总结：评论中讨论的核心问题是动物智能与人类独特性，以及语言与沟通的本质。不同评论者通过分享观点、个人经历和文献资料，探讨了动物是否拥有与人类类似的复杂沟通能力，以及人类对语言的定义是否需要扩展。

May 26, 2025
The GIST
Five-year study suggests chimpanzees strike stones against trees as form of communication
by
Wageningen University
edited by
Gaby Clark
, 																								reviewed by
Robert Egan
Editors' notes
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's
editorial process
and
policies
.
Editors
have highlighted
the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:
fact-checked
peer-reviewed publication
trusted source
proofread
This male chimpanzee in a nature reserve in Guinea-Bissau has just thrown a stone, an act captured by a camera trap. Credit: Chimbo Foundation.
A recent study by behavioral biologists from Wageningen University & Research and the German Primate Research Center has uncovered a remarkable phenomenon among wild chimpanzees in West Africa: the use of stones to produce sound, presumably as a form of communication.
Over the course of a five-year field study, the research team collected
video footage
at five distinct locations within a
nature reserve
in Guinea-Bissau. This was made possible through the use of camera traps and with essential support from local field guides. In specific areas, a striking behavioral pattern was observed: adult male chimpanzees repeatedly struck stones against
tree trunks
, resulting in characteristic piles of stones at the base of these trees.
The study is
published
in the journal
Biology Letters
.
Lead author Sem van Loon refers to this behavior as "stone-assisted drumming." "It appears to be related to the classic drumming with hands or feet on hollow buttress roots, which chimpanzees use to convey information over long distances or to display dominance," she explains.
Yet there are clear differences: prior to throwing stones, the animals are more likely to emit loud pant-hoots, followed by silence—an opposite pattern to traditional drumming, where silence typically precedes the noise.
Van Loon suspects a different motivation behind this behavior. "It may be that these loud, low-frequency sounds are meant to carry further than typical within-group communication," she suggests. "The acoustic properties of a stone striking a tree make that feasible in densely forested areas."
The observations point to cultural transmission. Young chimpanzees adopt the behavior from older group members, indicating that it is learned socially rather than genetically inherited.
Marc Naguib, Professor of Behavioral Ecology, underscores the broader significance of the discovery: "It illustrates that culture is not unique to humans and that such behaviors need to be considered also in nature conservation."
More information:
Sem van Loon et al, Stone-assisted drumming in Western chimpanzees and its implications for communication and cultural transmission,
Biology Letters
(2025).

data.article_summary: `typed-ffmpeg` 是一个现代的 Python FFmpeg 包装库，提供全面的复杂滤镜支持，并附带详细的类型标注和文档。它具有零依赖、用户友好、全面的 FFmpeg 滤镜支持、集成文档、强大的类型检查、滤镜图序列化、图形可视化、验证与自动修正以及输入输出选项支持等特点。此外，它还支持部分评估，增强了滤镜图的灵活性。安装简单，通过 pip 安装即可使用，并可通过额外安装实现图形可视化。该库还提供交互式环境，便于用户实时测试和学习 FFmpeg 命令和滤镜。未来计划包括扩展 FFmpeg 版本和滤镜支持。

typed-ffmpeg
typed-ffmpeg
offers a modern, Pythonic interface to FFmpeg, providing extensive support for complex filters with detailed typing and documentation. Inspired by
ffmpeg-python
, this package enhances functionality by addressing common limitations, such as lack of IDE integration and comprehensive typing, while also introducing new features like JSON serialization of filter graphs and automatic FFmpeg validation.
Table of Contents
Features
Installation
Quick Usage
Documentation
Interactive Playground
Acknowledgements
Features
Zero Dependencies:
Built purely with the Python standard library, ensuring maximum compatibility and security.
User-Friendly:
Simplifies the construction of filter graphs with an intuitive Pythonic interface.
Comprehensive FFmpeg Filter Support:
Out-of-the-box support for most FFmpeg filters, with IDE auto-completion.
Integrated Documentation:
In-line docstrings provide immediate reference for filter usage, reducing the need to consult external documentation.
Robust Typing:
Offers static and dynamic type checking, enhancing code reliability and development experience.
Filter Graph Serialization:
Enables saving and reloading of filter graphs in JSON format for ease of use and repeatability.
Graph Visualization:
Leverages
graphviz
for visual representation, aiding in understanding and debugging.
Validation and Auto-correction:
Assists in identifying and fixing errors within filter graphs.
Input and Output Options Support:
Provide a more comprehensive interface for input and output options, including support for additional codecs and formats.
Partial Evaluation:
Enhance the flexibility of filter graphs by enabling partial evaluation, allowing for modular construction and reuse.
Planned Features
Please note that the following features are under consideration or development for future releases:
Extended FFmpeg Version Support:
While
typed-ffmpeg
is currently built with FFmpeg version 6.0 in mind, we are working to ensure compatibility across different FFmpeg versions. Feedback and issue reports are welcome to improve version support.
Additional Filter Support:
We aim to expand the range of FFmpeg filters supported by
typed-ffmpeg
. Continuous updates will be made to include more complex and varied filters.
Installation
To install
typed-ffmpeg
, simply use pip:
pip install typed-ffmpeg
Note: FFmpeg must be installed on your system.
Note: If you need to install
ffmpeg-python
at the same time, use
pip install typed-ffmpeg-compatible
to prevent conflicts with the module name.​

To enable graph visualization features:

'
typed-ffmpeg[graph]
'

data.title: Edamagit: Magit for VSCode
data.author: tosh
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了VSCode的Magit插件——Edamagit，它受到原版Magit的启发，提供键盘驱动的Git界面。主要功能包括各种Git操作（如提交、分支管理、合并、重置等），并支持Vim键位绑定。用户可以通过命令面板访问所有Magit操作，并且键绑定可自定义。此外，还支持Forge功能（如显示拉取请求和问题），以及多种设置选项（如窗口显示位置、隐藏部分状态视图等）。Edamagit还计划增加更多交互功能和Git特性支持，欢迎用户提出功能需求和问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Magit及其在不同编辑器中的替代品或受其启发的工具，特别是在VSCode中的实现，以及与Emacs中Magit的对比。

不同观点：
• **iLemming** 认为，VSCode中不可能有真正的"Magit"，因为Magit是Emacs的包，而不是扩展。Emacs的包可以互相调用和修改行为，而VSCode的扩展是孤立的，无法直接互相调用。因此，VSCode中的"Magit-like"工具无法达到Magit的灵活性和功能。

• **osener** 是一位长期使用Magit的用户，虽然主要使用VSCode，但仍因为Magit切换回Emacs。他尝试过其他Git工具（如jujutsu、VisualJJ、GG），但发现难以复制Magit的工作流，特别是在处理冲突和分阶段提交方面。

• **masfoobar** 表示，看到其他编辑器有Magit-inspired的工具是好事，但VSCode不太可能提供Emacs那样的灵活性。不过，对于大多数用户来说，VSCode的功能可能已经足够。

• **tarsius** 提供了一个受Magit启发的项目列表，展示了Magit设计的影响力。

• **tempodox** 不喜欢GitLens并在VSCode中使用外部工具，但对Edamagit可能让他回归使用VSCode内的Git工具表示期待。

• **kunzhi** 认为Magit是Git UI的黄金标准，没有其他工具能接近。

• **kombine** 使用Neogit（受Magit启发的Neovim工具）并乐于看到这些工具在主流IDE中传播。

• **zkry** 强调Emacs和Magit的持续创新，并指出Emacs的理念也在影响其他环境。同时，对将Emacs描述为过时和晦涩表示不满。

• **Robdel12** 因为Magit几乎被锁定在Emacs中，因为其他编辑器的Git解决方案不如Magit。

• **anonzzzies** 正在逐渐从VSCode转向Emacs，但其同事仍使用VSCode。

• **iib** 曾尝试在VSCode中配置Git相关的快捷键，但遇到一些技术困难和不稳定性。

• **tretiy3** 正在开发自己的Linux版Git工具，并进行宣传。

• **costrouc** 认为VSCode的Edamagit扩展几乎与Magit相同，但有时会失去焦点，这让他感到沮丧。

• **mcc1ane** 认为Sublime Text的GitSavvy工具可以与Magit媲美，甚至更好。

补充讨论：
• Magit的灵活性和与其他Emacs包的深度集成是其独特优势，而VSCode的扩展机制限制了这种集成。
• 用户对Magit的依赖和喜爱使其难以转向其他编辑器，即使他们的主要工作环境是其他编辑器。
• 不同的Git工具（如jujutsu、VisualJJ、GG、Neogit）被提及，但大多数用户发现难以复制Magit的工作流。
• 一些用户对Emacs的复杂性和学习曲线表示接受，甚至欣赏其"古怪"的特点，而另一些用户则对VSCode中的Git工具表示期待和需求。

• **iib** 曾尝试在VSCode中配置Git相关的快捷键，但遇到一些技术困难和不稳定性。

• **tretiy3** 正在开发自己的Linux版Git工具，并进行宣传。

• **costrouc** 认为VSCode的Edamagit扩展几乎与Magit相同，但有时会失去焦点，这让他感到沮丧。

• **mcc1ane** 认为Sublime Text的GitSavvy工具可以与Magit媲美，甚至更好。

补充讨论：
• Magit的灵活性和与其他Emacs包的深度集成是其独特优势，而VSCode的扩展机制限制了这种集成。
• 用户对Magit的依赖和喜爱使其难以转向其他编辑器，即使他们的主要工作环境是其他编辑器。
• 不同的Git工具（如jujutsu、VisualJJ、GG、Neogit）被提及，但大多数用户发现难以复制Magit的工作流。
• 一些用户对Emacs的复杂性和学习曲线表示接受，甚至欣赏其"古怪"的特点，而另一些用户则对VSCode中的Git工具表示期待和需求。

data.title: High-quality OLED displays now enabling integrated thin and multichannel audio
data.author: LorenDB
data.article_summary: POSTECH研究团队开发了全球首款基于像素的局部发声OLED技术，使OLED显示屏的每个像素都能同时发出不同声音，实现多声道音响效果。该技术通过在显示屏框架内嵌入超薄压电激励器，避免了外部硬件需求和声音串扰问题，成功在13英寸OLED面板上实现演示。这项创新使得移动设备、汽车、VR等领域的多感官体验成为可能，显示屏不再只是视觉输出设备，还能提供高质量的音频体验，同时保持OLED的轻薄设计。该研究已发表在《Advanced Science》期刊上。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OLED显示屏结合压电元件发声技术的可行性、应用潜力和技术限制

不同观点：
• [layer8] 和 [kragen] 认为，该技术并不是让显示屏的每个像素发声，而是通过在OLED面板后安装压电元件阵列（如3x3或5x4阵列）来实现发声，且该技术在LCD屏幕上不太适用。
• [lmpdev] 提出，振动是否可以通过触觉感知，并建议将其整合到触觉反馈技术中。
• [teekert] 指出，由于像素移动不能超过其大小，因此低频表现受限，且这可能影响分辨率。
• [walterbell] 和 [jtthe13] 质疑该技术在重现低频声音方面的能力，尤其在家庭环境中的应用可能需要额外的低音设备。
• [ComputerGuru] 认为，由于距离因素，屏幕上不同位置发出的声音难以区分，因此该技术应用可能较窄。
• [chris_engel] 担心在移动设备中，玻璃层会阻碍声音传递，影响音效。

补充讨论：
• [steelbrain] 提供了技术演示的音频记录链接，便于进一步了解该技术的实际效果。
• [Xss3] 提出该技术是否能像相控阵一样使用的问题。
• [tuukkah] 和 [amelius] 对多像素组合产生低频声音以及声音方向性控制提出疑问，特别是如何在玻璃覆盖的情况下实现定向声束。
• [ra120271] 关注该技术对显示屏耐用性的潜在影响，以及是否能根据用户位置定制声效场景。
• [amelius] 和 [charlie0] 进一步质疑音频和视频是否可以独立控制以及低频表现的实际效果。

争议焦点：
• 该技术是否真的能让每个“像素”发声，还是仅通过特定阵列实现。
• 在移动设备中，玻璃层对声音传递的影响。
• 该技术在重现低频声音方面的能力及其在实际应用中的有效性。

44112149.article_content:
Science News
from research organizations
High-quality OLED displays now enabling integrated thin and multichannel audio
Date:
May 21, 2025
Source:
Pohang University of Science & Technology (POSTECH)
Summary:
A research team has developed the world's first Pixel-Based Local Sound OLED technology. This breakthrough enables each pixel of an OLED display to simultaneously emit different sounds, essentially allowing the display to function as a multichannel speaker array. The team successfully demonstrated the technology on a 13-inch OLED panel, equivalent to those used in laptops and tablets.
Share:
Facebook
Twitter
Pinterest
LinkedIN
Email
FULL STORY
A research team led by Professor Su Seok Choi of the Department of Electrical Engineering at POSTECH (Pohang University of Science and Technology) and PhD candidate Inpyo Hong of the Graduate Program in Semiconductor Materials and Devices has developed the world's first Pixel-Based Local Sound OLED technology. This breakthrough enables each pixel of an OLED display to simultaneously emit different sounds, essentially allowing the display to function as a multichannel speaker array. The team successfully demonstrated the technology on a 13-inch OLED panel, equivalent to those used in laptops and tablets. The research has been published online in the journal
Advanced Science.
Visuals Meet Audio: Toward a Multisensory Display Era
While display technologies have evolved with significant advances in resolution, high dynamic range, and color accuracy -- particularly with OLEDs and QD-enhanced displays -- the industry now faces the need for breakthroughs that enhance not only image quality but also the realism and immersion of user experience.
As visual technologies approach maturity, integrating multisensory inputs -- such as seeing, hearing, and touch -- into displays has become a new frontier. Therefore, now displays are no longer passive panels that simply show images; they are evolving into immersive interfaces that engage multiple human senses. Among these, sound plays a critical role: research indicates that audiovisual synchronization accounts for nearly 90% of perceived immersion.
However, most current displays still require external soundbars or multi-channel speakers, which add bulk and create design challenges -- especially in compact environments like vehicle interiors, where integrating multiple speakers is difficult.
OLEDs with Built-in Pixel-Based Sound: A Game Changer
To address this, researchers have focused on integrating advanced sound capabilities directly into OLED panels, known for their slim, flexible form factors. While companies have explored attaching exciters to the back of TVs or bending OLEDs around speakers -- as seen at MWC 2024 by Samsung and OLED panel speaker by LG -- these methods still rely on bulky hardware and face challenges in accurate sound localization.
The core issue is that traditional exciters -- devices that vibrate to produce sound -- are large and heavy, making it difficult to deploy multiple units without interference or compromising the OLED's thin design. Additionally, sound crosstalk between multiple speakers leads to a lack of precise control over localized audio.
Crosstalk-Free Pixel-Based Local Sound Control integrated with real working OLED
The POSTECH team overcame these challenges by embedding ultra-thin piezoelectric exciters within the OLED display frame. These piezo exciters, arranged similarly to pixels, convert electrical signals into sound vibrations without occupying external space. Crucially, they are fully compatible with the thin form factor of OLED panels.
As a result, each pixel can act as an independent sound source, enabling Pixel-Based Local Sound technology. The researchers also developed a method to completely eliminate sound crosstalk, ensuring that multiple sounds from different regions of the display do not interfere with each other -- something previously unattainable in multichannel setups.
Real Applications: Mobile, Tablet, Laptop, TV, Automotive, VR, and Beyond
This innovation allows for truly localized sound experiences. For instance, in a car, the driver could hear navigation instructions while the passenger listens to music -- all from the same screen. In virtual reality or smartphones, spatial sound can dynamically adapt to the user's head or hand movements, enhancing realism and immersion.
Most notably, the technology was successfully implemented on a 13-inch OLED panel, proving its practical scalability and commercial viability. The display delivers high-quality audio directly from the screen, without the need for external speakers, all while preserving the slim and lightweight benefits of OLED.
A Word from the Researcher
"Displays are evolving beyond visual output devices into comprehensive interfaces that engage both sight and sound," said Professor Su Seok Choi. "This technology has the potential to become a core feature of next-generation devices, enabling sleek, lightweight desi

data.title: They used Xenon to climb Everest in days – is it the future of mountaineering?
data.author: nikcub
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Xenon气体在攀登珠穆朗玛峰中的使用及其争议

不同观点：
• Aurornis认为，关于Xenon气体辅助攀登珠峰的报道都指向同一个人Lukas Furtenbach，他正在推销使用Xenon气体辅助的珠峰旅游。Aurornis质疑这些报道的真实目的，认为它们只是懒散地传递Furtenbach的公关信息，而不是探讨科学或揭露所谓的Xenon性能增强的地下世界。

• Severusdd指出，Xenon并不是新鲜事物，早在2014年索契奥运会时就有传闻俄罗斯运动员使用，随后被世界反兴奋剂组织（WADA）禁止。尽管Xenon能短暂提升EPO水平，但meta分析并未显示其对性能的实际提升，尤其在8000米高度的安全性仍存疑。Severusdd将Xenon比作登山界的“碳板鞋”，但其失败风险是脑水肿。

• A_D_E_P_T提到，Xenon用于运动增强并非新鲜事，其他元素如钴也有类似效果。Xenon在赛马和军事潜水员中可能已有使用，尤其是需要减少氧气消耗的场景。

• Goric认为，Xenon对攀登效果的证明不足，因为这些攀登使用了辅助氧气，且未报告起始海拔和流量。此外，其他未使用Xenon的攀登者也取得了类似成绩。

• Comrade1234质疑Xenon的实际作用，指出其与使用 hypoxia tents（低氧帐篷）的叠加效果不明。

• Nine_k讨论了珠峰攀登的成就被辅助工具稀释的问题，并担忧如果Xenon成为趋势，可能会加剧攀登者的拥堵和费用问题。

• Etheryte强调，Xenon仅用于准备阶段而非实际攀登，这使得结果更加引人注目。但其担心错误使用Xenon可能导致致命后果。

• Meindnoch认为，作为业余攀登者，直接注射EPO（促红细胞生成素）即可，不必使用Xenon。

• Gnabgib提供了相关讨论链接，显示关于使用Xenon气体攀登珠峰的不同讨论。

• Nokeya指出，Xenon能缩短攀登时间，从而减少在珠峰的住宿、补给和人员费用，可能影响当地收入。

• Tonyhart7认为，使用Xenon的并非普通登山者，而是如“前特种部队”等特殊群体。

• Jebarker认为，如今攀登珠峰只是那些迷失人生方向的人的终极活动，象征着对生活竞争的错误理解。

• Zeristor提到，Xenon非常昂贵，并对其在人体中的未知触发效应表示惊讶。

• Vjvjvjvjghv预测，未来可能会使用外骨骼辅助攀登。

补充讨论：
• Xenon气体在其他领域（如赛马和军事）的潜在应用也被提及。
• 关于Xenon使用的安全性、科学性和经济影响的讨论贯穿评论。
• 不同评论者对Xenon是否真正提升攀登效果存在争议，尤其在其实际作用和伦理问题上。

data.title: Show HN: Entropy – Sharing screen is scary in SaaS age
data.author: RazCo
data.article_summary:
"Share Screens, Not Secrets" 介绍了一款名为 Entropy 的浏览器扩展程序，旨在保护用户在屏幕共享时避免泄露敏感信息（如秘密和个人身份信息，PII）。该工具提供实时检测，自动模糊处理潜在的敏感数据。它有不同的定价计划：

1. **Essential（免费）**：基本实时检测功能，包括正则表达式和熵检测。
2. **Pro（$3.99/月）**：增加自定义设置、复制粘贴警报和检测历史等功能。
3. **Enterprise**：面向团队，提供同步检测规则、集中策略执行、审计跟踪及与Slack/SIEM集成等高级功能。

Entropy 确保在屏幕共享时不泄露秘密信息，同时不影响浏览器性能和工作流。用户可以根据需求选择不同计划，保护个人和团队的数据安全。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一款用于隐藏屏幕上敏感信息（如API密钥、令牌等）的Chrome扩展程序的反馈与争议

不同观点：
• 支持并提供改进建议：
  ◦ [pinkmuffinere]  congratulates the launch but suggests making the tagline clearer. They also propose pivoting the product to serve ad agencies that need to obscure sensitive data.
  ◦ [ttoinou] 提出另一个产品创意，建议开发一个可以替换非秘密但仍需保密的信息的工具，例如文件路径或用户名，并用AI生成替代字符串。

• 技术与安全改进建议：
  ◦ [mattbessey] 认为高斯模糊不足以完全保护信息，建议采用其他更安全的隐藏方式，因为模糊处理可能被攻击者破解。
  ◦ [sureglymop] 也认为模糊处理不够安全，建议直接用黑色条块覆盖敏感信息。

• 隐私与安全担忧：
  ◦ [phoronixrly] 对扩展程序需要访问所有网站数据表示担忧，质疑其安全性，并指出模糊处理已被证明不够安全。还批评了该扩展的订阅收费模式。
  ◦ [bitbasher] 以讽刺口吻指出，分享屏幕时将秘密信息暴露给第三方LLM（大型语言模型）提供商存在风险。

• 商业可行性质疑：
  ◦ [CommenterPerson] 质疑该产品概念是否自相矛盾，因为一个用于隐藏秘密的工具本身可能暴露信息。
  ◦ [ajb] 认为，在安全方面，白名单机制优于黑名单机制，且人们已经可以通过只分享特定窗口来保护隐私，因此该产品可能没有足够的市场。

• 产品积极评价：
  ◦ [keepamovin] 认为该产品即使在不完全完成的状态下也有其价值，并赞赏其设计和努力，认为其"优雅降级"到不同客户层次。

• 其他安全实践建议：
  ◦ [nssnsjsjsjs] 强调了其他安全措施，如使用MFA（多因素认证）、VPN（虚拟专用网）、密钥库和JWT等，以避免依赖单一工具保护敏感信息。

补充讨论：
• 有人指出产品主页上有拼写错误（[stephantul]），这是一个小但值得注意的产品细节问题。
• 总体来看，评论中存在对产品安全性和商业可行性的争议，特别是关于模糊处理的安全性以及订阅收费模式的合理性。

44123535.article_summary:
"Share Screens, Not Secrets" 介绍了一款名为 Entropy 的浏览器扩展程序，旨在保护用户在屏幕共享时避免泄露敏感信息（如秘密和个人身份信息，PII）。该工具提供实时检测，自动模糊处理潜在的敏感数据。它有不同的定价计划：

1. **Essential（免费）**：基本实时检测功能，包括正则表达式和熵检测。
2. **Pro（$3.99/月）**：增加自定义设置、复制粘贴警报和检测历史等功能。
3. **Enterprise**：面向团队，提供同步检测规则、集中策略执行、审计跟踪及与Slack/SIEM集成等高级功能。

Entropy 确保在屏幕共享时不泄露秘密信息，同时不影响浏览器性能和工作流。用户可以根据需求选择不同计划，保护个人和团队的数据安全。
44123535.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一款用于隐藏屏幕上敏感信息（如API密钥、令牌等）的Chrome扩展程序的反馈与争议

不同观点：
• 支持并提供改进建议：
  ◦ [pinkmuffinere]  congratulates the launch but suggests making the tagline clearer. They also propose pivoting the product to serve ad agencies that need to obscure sensitive data.
  ◦ [ttoinou] 提出另一个产品创意，建议开发一个可以替换非秘密但仍需保密的信息的工具，例如文件路径或用户名，并用AI生成替代字符串。

• 技术与安全改进建议：
  ◦ [mattbessey] 认为高斯模糊不足以完全保护信息，建议采用其他更安全的隐藏方式，因为模糊处理可能被攻击者破解。
  ◦ [sureglymop] 也认为模糊处理不够安全，建议直接用黑色条块覆盖敏感信息。

• 隐私与安全担忧：
  ◦ [phoronixrly] 对扩展程序需要访问所有网站数据表示担忧，质疑其安全性，并指出模糊处理已被证明不够安全。还批评了该扩展的订阅收费模式。
  ◦ [bitbasher] 以讽刺口吻指出，分享屏幕时将秘密信息暴露给第三方LLM（大型语言模型）提供商存在风险。

• 商业可行性质疑：
  ◦ [CommenterPerson] 质疑该产品概念是否自相矛盾，因为一个用于隐藏秘密的工具本身可能暴露信息。
  ◦ [ajb] 认为，在安全方面，白名单机制优于黑名单机制，且人们已经可以通过只分享特定窗口来保护隐私，因此该产品可能没有足够的市场。

• 产品积极评价：
  ◦ [keepamovin] 认为该产品即使在不完全完成的状态下也有其价值，并赞赏其设计和努力，认为其"优雅降级"到不同客户层次。

• 其他安全实践建议：
  ◦ [nssnsjsjsjs] 强调了其他安全措施，如使用MFA（多因素认证）、VPN（虚拟专用网）、密钥库和JWT等，以避免依赖单一工具保护敏感信息。

补充讨论：
• 有人指出产品主页上有拼写错误（[stephantul]），这是一个小但值得注意的产品细节问题。
• 总体来看，评论中存在对产品安全性和商业可行性的争议，特别是关于模糊处理的安全性以及订阅收费模式的合理性。

data.author: hannofcart
data.article_summary: 文章对当前有关人工智能（AI）将带来巨大生产力提升的乐观预测提出质疑。作者Daron Acemoglu指出，尽管科技行业和媒体普遍认为AI将彻底改变世界经济，但经济理论和数据并不完全支持这些预测。根据现有研究，AI在自动化某些任务和提升部分工人的生产力方面可能产生影响，但总体效果有限。例如，ChatGPT等工具在简单写作任务上能节省约27%的劳动成本，而总体成本节省为14.4%。考虑到AI影响的任务比例（约4.6%），预估AI将在十年内使总要素生产率（TFP）提升0.66%，即每年0.06%。这远低于高盛和麦肯锡预测的数字。除非AI在科学发现或新产品创造上取得重大突破，否则其经济影响将较为有限。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI对社会、经济和各个行业的长短期影响及其预测的难度

不同观点：
• Nevermark认为，AI等技术的价值影响非常难以预测，尤其是能力进步与价值门槛之间的关系。他指出，技术进步可能不会立刻显现出其全部价值，且价值链的多层次性使得预测更加复杂。上游的突破可能会在下游遇到瓶颈，而下游的小突破可能会释放巨大的价值。

• jqpabc123以制造业为例，指出自动化已经在没有AI的情况下深入发展，比如现代汽车装配线的自动化程度非常高，人力成本在汽车制造中占比很小。他认为AI在制造业的进一步影响可能有限，因为自动化已经高度实现。

• mistercow认为，虽然长期预测AI的影响非常困难，但我们仍可以对未来三年的情况做出一些合理的预测。他强调，近期的经济影响主要涉及现有技术的改进，而对于更远的未来则充满不确定性。

• bko引用1998年诺贝尔奖得主保罗·克鲁格曼的话，指出互联网的影响在初期也曾被低估，并认为AI等新工具对社会和个人生产力的影响可能会逐渐显现。他表示，虽然有些人可能尚未充分利用这些工具，但他个人从中受益匪浅，并对未来持乐观态度。

• r721仅提及当前年份（2024），未展开具体讨论。

• jonstewart质疑某位经济学家的可信度，指出他之前曾为一份虚假AI论文站台，暗示对该专家关于AI影响的预测持怀疑态度。

补充讨论：
- 争议的焦点之一是对AI未来影响的预测可信度。Nevermark和mistercow强调预测的困难，而jonstewart则对某些专家的预测持怀疑态度。
- jqpabc123通过具体数据和实例（如汽车装配线）说明AI在某些领域的影响可能有限。
- bko通过历史类比（互联网的发展）指出，新技术的长期影响可能被低估，并强调个人经验中的积极影响。

Don’t Believe the AI Hype
May 21, 2024
Daron Acemoglu
If you listen to tech industry leaders, business-sector forecasters, and much of the media, you may believe that recent advances in generative AI will soon bring extraordinary productivity benefits, revolutionizing life as we know it. Yet neither economic theory nor the data support such exuberant forecasts.
BOSTON – According to tech leaders and many pundits and academics, artificial intelligence is poised to transform the world as we know it through unprecedented productivity gains. While some believe that machines soon will do
everything
humans can do, ushering in a new age of boundless prosperity, other predictions are at least more grounded. For example, Goldman Sachs
predicts
that generative AI will boost global GDP by 7% over the next decade, and the McKinsey Global Institute
anticipates
that the annual GDP growth rate could increase by 3-4 percentage points between now and 2040. For its part,
The Economist
expects that AI will create a
blue-collar bonanza
.
Trump’s Unworkable Trade Formula
Johannes Eisele/AFP/Getty Images
Economics
1
The Tragedy of Emmanuel Macron
Yves Herman/POOL/AFP via Getty Images
Longer Reads
3
US Fiscal Irresponsibility Is Everyone’s Problem
Anna Moneymaker/Getty Images
Economics
0
Is this realistic? As I note in a
recent paper
, the outlook is far more uncertain than most forecasts and guesstimates suggest. Still, while it is basically impossible to predict with any confidence what AI will do in 20 or 30 years, one can say something about the next decade, because most of these near-term economic effects must involve existing technologies and improvements to them.
It is reasonable to suppose that AI’s biggest impact will come from automating some tasks and making some workers in some occupations more productive. Economic theory provides some guidance for assessing these aggregate effects. According to
Hulten’s theorem
(named for economist Charles Hulten), aggregate “total factor productivity” (TFP) effects are simply the product of the share of tasks that are automated multiplied by the average cost savings.
While average cost savings are difficult to estimate and will vary by activity, there have already been some careful studies of AI’s effects on certain tasks. For example, Shakked Noy and Whitney Zhang have
examined the impact of ChatGPT
on simple writing tasks (such as summarizing documents or writing routine grant proposals or marketing material), while
Erik Brynjolfsson
, Danielle Li, and Lindsey Raymond have
assessed
the use of AI assistants in customer service. Taken together, this research suggests that currently available generative-AI tools yield average labor-cost savings of 27% and overall cost savings of 14.4%.
What about the share of tasks that will be affected by AI and related technologies? Using numbers from
recent studies
, I estimate this to be around 4.6%, implying that AI will increase TFP by only 0.66% over ten years, or by 0.06% annually. Of course, since AI will also drive an investment boom, the increase in GDP growth could be a little larger, perhaps in the 1-1.5% range.
These figures are much smaller than the ones from Goldman Sachs and McKinsey. If you want to get those bigger numbers, you either must boost the productivity gains at the micro level or assume that many more tasks in the economy will be affected. But neither scenario seems plausible. Labor-cost savings far above 27% not only fall out of the range offered by existing studies; they also do not align with the observed effects of other, even more promising technologies. For example, industrial robots have transformed some manufacturing sectors, and they appear to have reduced labor costs by
about 30%
.

It brings together 30 influential individuals from academia, policymaking, civil society, and the private sector — voices challenging conventional wisdom and blazing a new path.
Meet the Forward Thinkers
Similarly, we are unlikely to see far more than 4.6% of tasks being taken over, because AI is nowhere close to being able to perform most manual or social tasks (including seemingly simple functions with some social aspects, like accounting). As of 2019, a
survey
of essentially all US businesses found that only about 1.5% of them had any AI investments. Even if such investments have picked up over the past year and a half, we have a long, long way to go before AI becomes widespread.
Of course, AI could have larger effects than my analysis allows if it revolutionizes the process of scientific discovery or creates many new tasks and products. The recent AI-enabled discoveries of new
crystal structure

data.title: RSyncUI – A SwiftUI based macOS GUI for rsync
data.author: mickelsen
data.article_summary: RsyncUI 是一个基于 SwiftUI 的 macOS 应用程序，为命令行工具 rsync 提供图形用户界面（GUI），适用于 macOS Sonoma 及更高版本。它帮助用户组织同步任务和设置 rsync 参数，简化了 rsync 的使用。虽然 GUI 用于任务管理，但实际的同步任务是由 rsync 命令行工具执行的外部任务，RsyncUI 会监控其进度和终止状态，用户可以随时中止任务。RsyncUI 可通过 Homebrew 安装，并且已获得 Apple 的签名和公证。项目文档基于 Hugo 主题 Docsy，并使用 MIT 许可证发布。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕RsyncUI及其相关工具的功能、使用场景、安全性以及替代方案的讨论

不同观点：
• ctippett：提到Transmit也有同步文件夹的功能，并兼具SFTP/远程文件浏览器的用途，暗示可能有更多一体化解决方案。
• lproven：表示目前满足于使用Monterey系统和RSyncOSX，提到曾使用过ARsync，但由于其不再维护，因此转用RSyncOSX。对新旧版本的应用进行了比较。
• mhw：推荐Unison工具，认为它在双机同步场景下更为互动和智能，具有图形界面，允许用户调整同步算法，并能存储文件哈希以供后续同步使用。
• AnonC：认为rsync在特定重复任务中使用较为繁琐，需要经常查阅手册和测试参数，并建议补充Macports作为安装rsync的另一种方式。
• HeckFeck：对RsyncUI使用SwiftUI开发表示赞赏，认为桌面应用程序仍有发展空间。
• w10-1：关注RsyncUI的安全性，特别是XPC代码的使用和应用是否经过沙盒化处理，提出应注意外部进程的安全风险。
• dmarinus：不喜欢使用GUI工具，因此自行开发了基于命令行的rsync/rclone前端工具rzn，强调命令行操作的简洁性。
• Bender：希望RsyncUI能集成LFTP的前端功能，以便在无shell权限的场景下也能方便使用。
• joshstrange：表达了对Rclone类似前端工具的需求。
• MortyWaves：询问是否有好的rsync的Windows GUI工具。
• nesarkvechnep：从UI设计角度对RsyncUI提出批评，指出表格和侧边栏的填充有问题，建议使用NavigationStack改进侧边栏设计。

补充讨论：
• 工具之间的比较和替代：多个评论提到了不同的工具（如Transmit、RSyncOSX、ARsync、Unison、LFTP、Rclone）及其使用场景和优缺点。
• 安全性讨论：对RsyncUI应用的安全性，特别是XPC代码的使用和沙盒化问题，提出了潜在的安全风险和改进建议。
• 用户界面和体验：对SwiftUI开发的RsyncUI界面设计提出了具体意见，反映出用户对UI设计细节的关注。
• 不同平台的需求：有用户询问Windows平台上的类似工具，显示出跨平台需求的广泛性。

主要讨论点：对Easylang（或Tiki）编程语言的评价与讨论，包括其特点、用途及与其他语言的比较。

不同观点：
• **[abjr]** 认为Easylang可能只是Tiki的重新品牌化，并提到该语言的作者每年都用它来完成AoC（Advent of Code）挑战，他自己在尝试中也参考过这些内容。

• **[7thaccount]** 认为Easylang虽然简单，但让他想起自己梦想中的简单命令驱动语言，能够以简单的方式完成任务。他希望有一种像PowerShell但更快、支持更多功能的语言，尤其是图形相关功能，并指出调用Microsoft GUI工具非常麻烦且性能低下。

• **[layer8]** 将Easylang与Comal 80进行比较，后者是一种介于Basic和Pascal之间的编程语言，带有旧式REPL和类似Logo的海龟图形功能。

• **[chrisbrandow]** 表示Easylang引起了他的共鸣，他认为这种简单的编程语言比Scratch更有用，尤其是如果有一个独立的简单画布和文本/控制台输出，而这与编辑器分开。他认为Easylang实现了这一点，并对此表示赞赏。

• **[jcmontx]** 认为Easylang像是一种用于图形的DSL（领域特定语言），并对此表示赞赏。

• **[mdaniel]** 提到Easylang似乎是GPLv3许可，但注意到其中声明“All rights reserved”的行与GPLv3不兼容，因为GPLv3旨在授予权利而非保留权利。他还提到Easylang尚未自托管，对此表示遗憾。

• **[xunil2ycom]** 简单地认为Easylang基本上就是Logo语言。

• **[bn-l]** 质疑Easylang的目标受众，尤其是如果目标是孩子，他认为这完全偏离了目标。

补充讨论：
• 关于Easylang是否是Tiki的重新品牌化存在疑问。
• 对Easylang与PowerShell、Comal 80、Logo等其他语言的比较和联系。
• 对Easylang在性能、功能和易用性方面的评价。
• 对Easylang许可问题的关注，特别是“All rights reserved”与GPLv3的兼容性问题。
• 对Easylang目标受众的质疑，尤其是对于儿童教育用途的适用性。

争议焦点：Easylang的目标受众及其在儿童编程教育中的适用性存在争议。

data.title: From Finite Integral Domains to Finite Fields
data.author: susam
data.article_summary:
这篇文章探讨了抽象代数中关于域和整环的一些已知结果。文章首先定义了整环，指出它是一个无零因子的交换环，并给出了几个例子，如整数环 $\mathbb{Z}$ 和素数模整数环 $\mathbb{Z}_p$。接着，文章讨论了已知的一些命题，例如在环中任何元素与零的乘积都是零。然后，文章证明了每个域都是整环，因为域中的每个非零元素都有乘法逆元，从而满足无零因子的条件。

文章进一步探讨了有限整环的性质，证明了每个有限整环都是域。这是通过考虑环中的乘法逆元和利用鸽巢原理来实现的。最后，文章总结了所有讨论的结果，重申了域和整环之间的关系，并提出了一个替代证明来加强论述的完整性。

简而言之，文章明确了每个域都是整环，并且每个有限整环必然是域。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于积分域与域的性质以及相关数学定理的讨论

不同观点：
• [clintonc] 认为可以使用更高阶的集合论结果，即有限集上的单射也是满射，来简要证明每个积分域都是一个域。他指出，通过取消性质可以说明乘法是单射，从而也是满射，即1在范围内，从而得到乘法逆元。

• [getnormality] 提到了Wedderburn小定理，该定理表明任何有限除环都是交换的，因此是一个域。他强调了这个结果的惊人之处，因为环的部分目的是研究非交换代数，而像n x n实矩阵（n > 1）这样的重要环确实是非交换的。他还指出，四元数是一个非交换的除环，不适用于该定理，因为它是无限的。

• [Tainnor] 讨论了在域中处理零因子问题的方法。他认为对于域F中的元素a和b使得ab=0的情况，可以直接考虑a=0和a≠0两种情况。如果a=0，则无需证明ab=0；如果a≠0，则可以通过左乘a的逆元来简化证明。

• [revskill] 提出了一个更基础的问题，即成为域的意义是什么，暗示对域的基本概念和其在数学中的作用存在疑问。

补充讨论：
• [getnormality] 还提到，虽然Wedderburn小定理的证明在专业数学标准中相对简单，但他个人认为自己难以构思出这样的证明。

• 讨论中涉及了数学证明的简洁性和优雅性，例如[clintonc]和[Tainnor]都提到了简化证明的方法。

• 争议的焦点可能在于证明方法的复杂性和不同数学结果之间的关系，例如有限与无限除环的区别及其在域理论中的应用。

总结：讨论围绕积分域与域的性质展开，涉及高阶集合论结果和具体数学定理的应用，同时对证明方法的简洁性和域的基本概念进行了探讨。

44097362.article_content:
From Finite Integral Domains to Finite Fields
By
Susam Pal
on 25 May 2025
In this article, we explore a few well-known results from abstract
algebra pertaining to fields and integral domains.  We ask ourselves
whether every field is an integral domain, and whether every
integral domain is a field.  We begin with the definition of an
integral domain, discuss a few established results, and then proceed
to answer these questions.  Familiarity with algebraic structures
such as rings and fields is assumed.
Contents
Definition of Integral Domain
Examples of Integral Domains
Known Results
On Distinct Identities
Every Field Is an Integral Domain
Infinite Integral Domains
Every Finite Integral Domain Is a Field
Alternate Proof
Conclusion
Definition of Integral Domain
An
integral domain
is a commutative ring, with distinct
additive and multiplicative identities, in which the product of any
two non-zero elements is also non-zero.
Equivalently, an integral domain is a commutative ring, with
distinct additive and multiplicative identities, such that if the
product of two elements is zero, then one of the elements must be
zero.
Using standard notation, we can write that a commutative ring \( R
\) is an integral domain if \( 0 \ne 1 \) and for \( a, b \in R, \)
\[
a \ne 0 \text{ and } b \ne 0 \implies a \cdot b \ne 0
\]
or equivalently,
\[
a \cdot b = 0 \implies a = 0 \text{ or } b = 0.
\]
There are many other alternative ways to define an integral domain
which are all equivalent.  In a ring \( R, \) a
zero
divisor
is a non-zero element \( a \in R \) such that there
exists a non-zero element \( b \in R \) with \( ab = 0.  \)  With
this definition of a zero divisor, we can define an integral domain
to be a unital commutative ring, with \( 0 \ne 1, \) that has no
zero divisors.
Examples of Integral Domains
The ring of integers \( \mathbb{Z} \) is an integral domain since
the product of two non-zero integers is non-zero.  The field of
rational numbers \( \mathbb{Q} \) is also an integral domain.  The
ring of polynomials in the indeterminate \( t \) with coefficients
in an integral domain \( R, \) denoted \( R[t], \) is an integral
domain as well.
The ring of integers modulo 5, denoted \( \mathbb{Z}_5 \) is an
integral domain.  However, the ring of integers modulo 6, denoted \(
\mathbb{Z}_6, \) is not an integral domain since \( 2 \cdot 3 = 0 \)
in \( \mathbb{Z}_6.  \)  In other words, \( \mathbb{Z}_6 \) has zero
divisors, namely \( 2 \) and \( 3, \) so it is not an integral
domain.  In fact, the ring of integers modulo \( n, \) denoted \(
\mathbb{Z}_n \) is an integral domain if and only if \( n \) is
prime.
Known Results
For the sake of brevity, we assume the following known results.
Proposition 1.
Let \( R \) be a ring.  Then, for all \( a \in R, \) we have
\[
a \cdot 0 = 0 \cdot a = 0.
\]
Proposition 2.
Let \( D \) be an integral domain.  Then, for all \( a, b, c \in D \) such
that \( a \ne 0, \) we have
\[
a \cdot b = a \cdot c \implies b = c.
\]
The second result is also known as the
cancellation property of
integral domains
.
On Distinct Identities
We have been mentioning the distinctiveness of the additive and
multiplicative identities as a property of an integral domain.  Some
texts express this more concisely by saying that an integral domain
is a
non-zero
unital commutative ring without zero
divisors, i.e., the zero ring \( \{ 0 \} \) is excluded from the
definition.
This follows directly from
Proposition 1
.  If \( 0 = 1 \in R
, \) then for all \( r \in R, \) we get
\[
r = r \cdot 1 = r \cdot 0 = 0
\]
which means that every element of \( R \) is zero, i.e., \( R = \{ 0
\}.  \)  To summarise
\[ 0 = 1 \in R \implies R = \{ 0 \} \]
or equivalently, for a ring \( R \) with unity,
\[
R \ne \{ 0 \} \implies 0 \ne 1.
\]
Further, if \( 0 \) and \( 1 \) are two distinct elements of \( R
, \) then \( R \) has at least two elements, so for a ring \( R \)
with unity,
\[
0 \ne 1 \implies R \ne \{ 0 \}
\]
Therefore, a ring with unity has distinct additive and
multiplicative identities if and only if it is a non-zero ring.  This
is why an integral domain can also be defined as a non-zero unital
commutative ring without zero divisors.
Every Field Is an Integral Domain
We now show that every field is indeed an integral domain.  Let \( F
\) be a field, and let \( a, b \in F \) such that \( ab = 0.  \)
There are two cases to consider: \( a = 0 \) and \( a \ne 0.  \)  If
\( a = 0, \) then indeed \( ab = 0 \)
by
Proposition 1
.
Now suppose \( a \ne 0.  \)  Then by the properties of fields, there exists a
multiplicative inverse \( a^{-1} \in F \) such that \( a \cdot
a^{-1} = 1.  \)  Then using the properties of fields, we get
\[
b = b \cdot 1 = b \cdot (a \cdot a^{-1}) = (a \cdot b) \cdot
a^{-1} = 0 \cdot a^{-1} = 0.
\]
The last equality follows from
Proposition 1
.  We have shown
that if \( ab = 0, \) then either \( a = 0 \) or \( b = 0.  \)
Therefore, if both \( a \ne 0 \) and \( b \ne 0, \) then it must be
that \( ab \ne 0.  \)  Th

这篇文章探讨了抽象代数中关于域和整环的一些已知结果。文章首先定义了整环，指出它是一个无零因子的交换环，并给出了几个例子，如整数环 $\mathbb{Z}$ 和素数模整数环 $\mathbb{Z}_p$。接着，文章讨论了已知的一些命题，例如在环中任何元素与零的乘积都是零。然后，文章证明了每个域都是整环，因为域中的每个非零元素都有乘法逆元，从而满足无零因子的条件。

文章进一步探讨了有限整环的性质，证明了每个有限整环都是域。这是通过考虑环中的乘法逆元和利用鸽巢原理来实现的。最后，文章总结了所有讨论的结果，重申了域和整环之间的关系，并提出了一个替代证明来加强论述的完整性。

简而言之，文章明确了每个域都是整环，并且每个有限整环必然是域。

主要讨论点：关于积分域与域的性质以及相关数学定理的讨论

不同观点：
• [clintonc] 认为可以使用更高阶的集合论结果，即有限集上的单射也是满射，来简要证明每个积分域都是一个域。他指出，通过取消性质可以说明乘法是单射，从而也是满射，即1在范围内，从而得到乘法逆元。

• [getnormality] 提到了Wedderburn小定理，该定理表明任何有限除环都是交换的，因此是一个域。他强调了这个结果的惊人之处，因为环的部分目的是研究非交换代数，而像n x n实矩阵（n > 1）这样的重要环确实是非交换的。他还指出，四元数是一个非交换的除环，不适用于该定理，因为它是无限的。

• [Tainnor] 讨论了在域中处理零因子问题的方法。他认为对于域F中的元素a和b使得ab=0的情况，可以直接考虑a=0和a≠0两种情况。如果a=0，则无需证明ab=0；如果a≠0，则可以通过左乘a的逆元来简化证明。

• [revskill] 提出了一个更基础的问题，即成为域的意义是什么，暗示对域的基本概念和其在数学中的作用存在疑问。

不同观点：
• [reverendsteveii] 对公司未经同意收集信息且无法选择退出、未能保护信息的做法表示不满。他认为公司提供的身份盗窃监控服务并不值得，因为用户可以免费获得类似服务。同时，他提到律师可能会从相关诉讼中获利。
   
• [T3OU-736] 对GitHub凭据泄露和个人信息（如社会安全号码，SSN）泄露之间的关系感到困惑。他认为如果SSN被存储在GitHub仓库中或通过GitHub访问的数据库中包含SSN，这本身就是严重的问题。

• [pards] 引用了文章内容，指出威胁者访问了公司的GitHub账户并获取了“一些软件制品以及一些个人信息”。他进一步分析，LexisNexis提供的信用检查和制裁筛查软件可能比个人数据更有价值，因为这些软件可能被用于规避金融系统的监管，从而进行欺诈和洗钱等活动。

• [prepend] 纠正了文章中的一个细节错误，指出LexisNexis风险解决方案公司（LNRS）的总部位于Alpharetta，而非亚特兰大，并提供了维基百科链接作为参考。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是GitHub凭据泄露如何导致个人信息（如社会安全号码）的泄露，以及这种技术细节是否合理。
• 另一个讨论点是公司提供的身份盗窃监控服务的实际价值，以及公司在信息保护方面的失责问题。
• 还有人关注泄露事件对金融系统和监管规避的潜在影响，强调了软件源码泄露可能带来的更广泛风险。

data.title: The Crafters of "Andor"
data.author: SLHamlet
data.article_summary: 《Andor》被誉为本世纪最出色的《星球大战》作品，甚至可能是史上最佳。该剧由托尼·吉尔罗伊主创，具有深刻的反法西斯主题，精致的制作设计，并关注供应链问题，极具个人特色。它与《星球大战》其他作品截然不同，预算庞大，挑战观众，实属难得。尽管网上分析众多，但许多过于表面，聚焦于粉丝考据，而忽视了其丰富的主题和独立于粉丝服务之外的艺术价值。该剧也带来了丰富的幕后访谈，创作者们深入探讨了他们的艺术选择和未被采纳的方向，提供了难得的创作洞见，令人想起DVD时代的幕后花絮。这些访谈展示了顶尖创作者如何重塑这个已有近半个世纪历史的宇宙，值得一看。

44111248.article_content:
It's hard for me to articulate just how much I love "Andor", the best Star Wars entertainment of at least this century, and maybe ever. Tony Gilroy's long been a favorite of mine (friends will know that I need
very
little prompting to wax rhapsodic about
Michael Clayton
, his greatest film) so it was no surprise that I would be inclined to like the show. But when it turned out to be a deeply ruminative, unabashedly anti-fascist show with lavish production design and a recurring fixation on supply chains, it's like it was crafted specifically to appeal to me personally.
There are lots of analyses of the show online, some fairly sophisticated, but too many suffer from being fairly facile as online fandoms have been trained to pursue "find the reference to the wiki lore!" rituals, and so they struggle to deal with a thematically rich work that is plainly indifferent to fan service. It also emphasizes just how
unlikely
it is that this series exists at all, striking such a different tone from anything else in the franchise, being given such an extravagant budget, and being allowed to challenge its audience in a way that no major studio has ever allowed a top-tier blockbuster cinematic universe to do.
If there's one thing Star Wars fans love, it's hating Star Wars, and so the only way we can ever truly praise a Star Wars work is by implicitly insulting all of them, usually in one of these two ways: This is Star Wars for adults! This is Star Wars for people who don't like Star Wars! Sure, it's those things, and it's genuinely good prestige TV (I say that as someone who generally despises prestige TV), but it's also
good
Star Wars) and I am not a person prone to "guilty pleasures"; I find no shame in enjoying a franchise that is enormously popular and that's been a fun form of entertainment in movies and shows and video games and toys since I was a kid.
Wither DVD Extras
But what has been a wonderful surprise is discovering that so many of the brilliantly talented artists behind "Andor" have participated in deep, thoughtful conversations about their work on the show. They've gone into deep detail about their artistic choices, and even discussed the directions that they
weren't
able to explore. On these kinds of streaming shows, there are always plenty of interviews with the cast that take the form of a typical press junket, and "Andor" has those, but they take the typical conventional form, and are not particularly interesting even though the actors are brilliant.
Fortunately, though, there are also a rich set of interviews with the creators responsible for aspects of production like the sound design, stunt choreography, set decoration, and writing — even Tony Gilroy himself talking about the combinations of writing and showrunning of the series. It is just an extraordinary glimpse at what it took to make the work. I grew up watching the "behind the scenes" documentaries that a generation of us pored over in the 80s and 90s as Star Wars fans before the DVD era. We felt like we'd won the lottery when DVDs arrived and suddenly studios felt like they had to expand their releases with an accompaniment of bonus material to entice fans to buy a copy of their favorite films. In the era before fan wikis and online fan culture in general, this was the only peek at how people made the creative work we were inspired by, in the same way that we would obsess over the liner notes on a favorite album.
Now it's as easy as a few clicks, and it is no surprise that the people who made "Andor" are also wonderfully articulate about how and why they made their choices while creating the series. If you enjoyed the show as much as I did, set aside some time and listen to how people who are operating at the very top of their game can make something amazing that reinvents a familiar universe after almost half a century.

• [duxup] 专注于对《Andor》这一电视剧的评价，认为该剧即便脱离《星球大战》的背景也能独立成佳作。他强调了该剧在视觉细节和道具使用上的精心制作，显示出对剧集质量的赞赏。

• [InTheArena] 将《Andor》与《星战前传》、《The Expanse》、《Battlestar Galactica》以及《Babylon 5》等作品进行对比，认为《Andor》达到了他心目中《星球大战》系列应有的水准。他批评了《星战前传》的商业化倾向，并赞扬《Andor》在情节发展和历史隐喻上的深度和严谨，认为其为后续作品奠定了更好的基础。

补充讨论：
• 《Andor》作为一部科幻剧集，获得了观众的高度评价，尤其在与《星球大战》其他系列作品的对比中，被认为在剧情和制作质量上更为出色。
• 流媒体时代的内容创作中，互动性和视觉艺术的缺失成为一个讨论焦点，尤其在与过去的DVD内容和Flash互动内容对比时，这一点更为明显。
• 对《Andor》的讨论中，观众对其情节和细节处理的赞赏反映出对高质量剧集的需求和期待。

data.title: A Song of “Full Self-Driving”
data.author: latexr
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论特斯拉和埃隆·马斯克在“完全自动驾驶”（FSD）技术上的承诺与现实差距。多年来，马斯克多次宣称特斯拉即将实现完全自动驾驶，但这些承诺一再落空，成为笑柄。尽管马斯克声称FSD即将推出，但具体细节模糊，且相关政府部门和公众并未得到充分沟通。相比之下，谷歌旗下的Waymo已经实现了真正的无人驾驶技术，特斯拉则明显落后。文章批评了将重大科技决策交给毫无头绪的巨富人士掌控的现象，并质疑特斯拉即将推出的“Robotaxi”是否只是噱头而非实际突破。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：特斯拉的全自动驾驶（FSD）技术及其可行性、技术路线、以及与竞争对手（如Waymo）的比较。

不同观点：
• **ddalex**：认为FSD要么是一个需要先进传感器和算法的高难度问题，要么是一个通过摄像头和神经网络可以轻松解决的简单问题。如果属于前者，Waymo有不可逾越的优势；如果是后者，任何公司都可以轻松复制特斯拉的技术。同时质疑特斯拉是否具有战略护城河。

• **x187463**：虽然认为FSD在大多数情况下表现不错，但指出其存在许多问题，如无法正确处理交通信号和限速等，且仅依靠摄像头无法实现完全无监督的FSD。分享了自己使用FSD时遇到的多个实际问题，认为特斯拉需要引入LIDAR等更多传感器。同时，也承认FSD在某些复杂驾驶场景中表现良好。

• **Coeur**：纠正关于LIDAR在自动驾驶技术中应用的错误信息，指出许多现有功能（如车道偏离检测和自适应巡航控制）并不依赖LIDAR，而是使用雷达和摄像头。同时，认为LIDAR可能在未来全自动驾驶中发挥重要作用，但目前尚未广泛应用。

• **bhouston**：对Elon Musk的个人行为和宣传方式提出批评，认为他虽然有远见和执行力，但也有过度承诺和偏见的问题，且在个人生活方面存在争议。

• **walthamstow**：指出谷歌街景车频繁采集数据，质疑其是否仅采集图像，还是同时采集其他数据，认为这可能对自动驾驶技术的发展有帮助。

• **jp57**：质疑Waymo的FSD技术是否真正实现了完全自动驾驶，指出其可能依赖远程人工干预，但未公开具体细节。

• **amarcheschi**：提到一首关于Musk和特斯拉的歌曲，未深入讨论技术问题。

• **kklisura**：引用法律诉讼案例，指出Musk在FSD技术上的承诺被指夸大甚至误导，且法律团队成功辩护称这些承诺属于“企业乐观的模糊陈述”和“ mere puffing”。

• **cbeach**：认为许多文章对Musk和FSD的批评是基于个人和政治偏见，而非实质性技术评价，并指出FSD在现实世界中的进展显著，优于依赖地理围栏和安全驾驶员的Waymo。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于FSD技术是否能够仅依靠摄像头实现完全自动驾驶，以及特斯拉与Waymo等竞争对手的技术优劣对比。
• 部分评论者对Musk的个人行为和宣传方式提出批评，认为其承诺不可全信。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是关于LIDAR等传感器的必要性，一些评论者认为特斯拉需要引入更多传感器以提高FSD的安全性和可靠性。

Hey fam:
Supersized newsletter today. This Triad goes to
four
.
It’s about Tesla and Elon Musk and autonomous vehicles. It gets fairly technical at times. But it’s really about how we’ve turned over large portions of America to insanely rich people who have no idea what they’re doing.
It’s about oligarchy and technology. I hope you’ll take the ride with me—and share it if you are so inclined.
Join
P.S.: If this edition ends abruptly in your inbox, click the title to get to the full version on the site. Like I said—it’s a long one.
Cybercab! (Composite / GettyImages / Shutterstock)
1. “Full Self Driving”
For years, Elon Musk has been promising that Teslas will operate completely autonomously in “Full Self Driving” (FSD) mode. And when I say years, I mean
years
:
December 2015
: “We’re going to end up with complete autonomy, and I think we will have complete autonomy in approximately two years.”
January 2016
: “In ~2 years, summon should work anywhere connected by land & not blocked by borders, eg you’re in LA and the car is in NY.”
June 2016
: “I really would consider autonomous driving to be basically a solved problem. . . . I think we’re basically less than two years away from complete autonomy, complete—safer than a human. However regulators will take at least another year.”
October 2016
: By the end of 2017 Tesla will demonstrate a fully autonomous drive from “a home in L.A., to Times Square . . . without the need for a single touch, including the charging.”
March 2018
: “I think probably by end of next year [end of 2019] self-driving will encompass essentially all modes of driving”
February 2019
: “I think we will be feature complete—full self-driving—this year. Meaning the car will be able to find you in a parking lot, pick you up, take you all the way to your destination without an intervention, this year."
I’m going to stop the litany here, but it continued. For a decade Tesla’s “Full Self Driving” has been
a running joke
. Every year, Musk says that FSD is months, or weeks away. Every year it slips over the horizon. And every year the media and the stock market pretend that Musk hasn’t failed.
But now Tesla’s FSD is really, truly, absolutely about to happen.
Maybe
.
Tesla “Robotaxis” are coming to Austin in June and Elon Musk says they are the future of the company.
1
Facing declining consumer sales, the company’s valuation is based on the idea that Tesla is about to transform the auto industry by turning car ownership into something akin to software-as-a-service.
2
As usual, the details are murky.
Fortune
reports
that as of this week Tesla still has not briefed many of the relevant authorities in Austin about what the company’s Robotaxis are, how they will operate, or how first responders and law enforcement are supposed to deal with them.
3
And the cars that appear on the street aren’t going to be the “Robotaxis” Musk keeps promising. They will be modified Model Y’s.
Also, there will only be 10 to 20 of them.
You may be forgiven for wondering if this Robotaxi launch will be a real proof-of-concept for autonomous driving, or the Tesla version of Amazon’s “
Just Walk Out
” technology.
4
Share
Of course we already have full self-driving technology. It’s called Waymo, it’s run by Google, and it operates a driverless taxi service in a growing number of cities across America. Just a few days ago, Tesla’s head of self-driving
admitted
that Tesla FSD is “a couple years” behind Waymo, which in Elon-speak probably means a decade. Or more.
So in a sense, Musk was correct that autonomous driving is a “solved problem.” Just not by him.
We have been chasing the driverless car for
a hundred years
. During that time people have tried all sorts of paradigms. At the 1939 World’s Fair, General Motors proposed a system of remote-controlled cars. (Put a pin in that.) At another phase, people thought that beacons on roadways could emit signals to guide cars or that “
world maps
” could give the car’s brain a detailed enough view for them to navigate on their own. Starting in the early 2000s the industry settled on the idea of making cars that navigated by “sensing” their surroundings.
This movement was
kickstarted by a DARPA challenge
(government intervention for the win) and only after university researchers showed that the sensing paradigm held promise did tech companies pile into the space.
5
Google started working on self-driving cars in 2009
6
and it was a slog. Initially they focused on the use of cameras to understand what was happening around the vehicle’s environment.

But no ma

data.title: Derek Muller Confronts PFAS "Forever Chemicals"–In His Own Blood
data.author: ibobev
data.article_summary: YouTube科普明星德里克·穆勒（Derek Muller）以其频道Veritasium吸引了1800万订阅者，他通过挑战科学误解而广受欢迎。最近，他的一项血液检测发现体内存在被称为“永久化学品”的PFAS（全氟和多氟烷基物质）。这一发现正值美国环保署（EPA）突然撤销PFAS防护措施，使穆勒的工作显得尤为紧迫。在他的最新视频《一家公司如何秘密毒害地球》中，穆勒深入探讨了PFAS的危害，该视频时长近一小时，发布一天内就获得近300万观看。视频不仅揭露了企业不当行为，还详细解释了这些“永久化学品”对人类的危害。穆勒在科学教育和影视制作之间曾面临职业选择，最终通过Veritasium实现了将两者结合的独特价值。他的视频强调了困惑和挑战在学习中的重要性，并通过自己的例子警示公众关注PFAS污染这一紧迫健康问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：PFAS化学物质的危害及相关企业和机构的责任

不同观点：
• [Neywiny] 认为电影《Dark Waters》揭示了PFAS问题，尤其是对无辜受害者的影响。该评论强调了电影在提高公众对PFAS危害认识方面的作用，并对那些在抗争中失败的人表示关注。

• [chiph] 提到因为了解到微波爆米花袋内涂层会释放PFAS化学物质，已改回使用炉灶制作爆米花。他对PFAS化学物质的释放机制有疑问，不确定这些化学物质是在货架上释放还是在微波加热时释放。他还引用了视频链接以支持其观点。

• [nullc] 的评论简短且带有讽刺意味，表示对问题解决不抱希望，可能暗示对当前情况的无能为力或失望。

• [bluesounddirect] 提供了一个存档链接，可能与讨论的主题相关，但没有详细阐述自己的观点。

• [more_corn] 批评了企业（如3M）在PFAS问题上长达数十年的隐瞒行为，并对公共机构在保护公众免受PFAS危害方面的无所作为表示愤怒。评论强调了3M公司在问题曝光后的宽恕以及机构在规则撤销方面的失职。

补充讨论：
• PFAS化学物质的来源和释放机制是讨论中的一个重要问题，尤其是[chiph]提出的微波爆米花袋涂层问题及其具体释放方式。
• 企业和公共机构在PFAS问题上的责任和失职是另一个讨论焦点，[more_corn]特别强调了公司隐瞒行为和机构不作为对公众健康的威胁。
• 电影《Dark Waters》在提高公众意识方面的作用被[Neywiny]视为积极的，但其他评论更关注实际问题的解决和责任追究。

争议焦点：企业和公共机构在PFAS问题上的责任及公众如何获得有效保护。

YouTube Science Star Derek Muller Confronts PFAS “Forever Chemicals”—In His Own Blood
YouTube star Derek Muller built an 18-million-subscriber YouTube empire by challenging misconceptions about science. Now his own blood test and a sudden EPA reversal give his work urgent relevance.
By
Deni Ellis Béchard
edited by
Dean Visser
Veritasium YouTube star Derek Muller discovered PFAS forever chemicals in his blood.
Simon Dawson/Bloomberg/Getty Images
As the creator of Veritasium, a science education YouTube channel with 18 million subscribers, Derek Muller has spent the past 15 years exploring a counterintuitive vision for learning: Clarity numbs the mind, but confusion can crack it open. His audience has grown because of how he challenges common misconceptions about the laws of nature, and his rise has paralleled YouTube’s, whose creator-focused approach has made it the world’s largest streaming service by almost every measure—from content library to audience size—recently surpassing Netflix in revenue. Amid this symbiosis, Veritasium evolved—from unpolished five-minute clips of Muller quizzing people on the street to technically sophisticated science explorations with the satisfying depth of feature films. Muller himself has appeared in many roles: trickster science teacher, experimenter with a mad-scientist flair, fearless investigator in the mold of Indiana Jones. And in Veritasium’s most recent video, one of the channel’s longest yet, he steps forward as an advocate for one of today’s most pressing health issues:
the toxic “forever chemicals”
that are now being found to contaminate almost every human being, animal and ecosystem on Earth. Entitled
How One Company Secretly Poisoned the Planet
, the video clocks in at nearly an hour and garnered almost three million views within a day. It is not only an exposé of corporate malfeasance but also a
scientific explainer of these forever chemicals (known as perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS) and their harm to humans
. It debuted on the same day that the Environmental Protection Agency announced sweeping rollbacks of PFAS safeguards, supercharging the video’s impact. Leveraging his audience, resources and cinematic craft, Muller has now focused Veritasium on a crisis whose invisible poisons, as the film’s finale reveals, are already circulating in his own blood.
Learning from Wrong Answers
Teaching began early for Muller. Born in Traralgon, Australia, in 1982, he relocated to Vancouver as a toddler and so excelled in school that his teachers sometimes invited him to tutor the class. “There was a certain way in which science appeared like magic,” he recalls—invoking science-fiction giant Arthur C. Clarke’s adage that any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from sorcery. He remembers ordinary school experiments—the upside-down glass that keeps a tissue dry underwater and the soda-and-Mentos fountain. But what stuck was the sense that the universe kept secrets only curiosity could unlock. “Isn’t it everything?” he says when asked why science matters. “Isn’t it obvious that it’s the most important thing?”
On supporting science journalism
If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by
subscribing
. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
When Muller graduated, he was torn between pursuing filmmaking and science. He wanted to be “uniquely useful,” he says. “I felt like if I went into science, maybe I would be a swappable cog in some sort of machine.” But he also feared that pursuing film might have him running coffees in Los Angeles in hopes of making the right connection and getting a break. He took a full scholarship in engineering physics at Queen’s University in Ontario and then decamped to Sydney, Australia, to pursue film—only to learn that the Australian Film, Television and Radio School admits just a handful of students per program each year. Lacking a portfolio, he wandered into the University of Sydney’s physics department in hopes of a tutoring gig and stayed to do a doctorate on how people learn—or fail to. In classes, he noticed that students often nodded appreciatively but retained almost nothing. “If you perform a demonstration and don’t force the class to make a prediction,” he says, “they’ll learn about as much as if they never saw the demonstration at all.”
Muller’s doctoral thesis compared two instructional video styles, which were viewed by undergraduates at the University of Sydney. The first featured an actor delivering a polished, textbook explanation of Newton’s laws. Participants described this version as easy to follow. The second portrayed a student repeatedly stumbling over the laws while a tutor tried to set him straight. Most viewers found this depiction confusing. But when tested on the concepts, participants who called the textbook account
44123945.article_summary: YouTube科普明星德里克·穆勒（Derek Muller）以其频道Veritasium吸引了1800万订阅者，他通过挑战科学误解而广受欢迎。最近，他的一项血液检测发现体内存在被称为“永久化学品”的PFAS（全氟和多氟烷基物质）。这一发现正值美国环保署（EPA）突然撤销PFAS防护措施，使穆勒的工作显得尤为紧迫。在他的最新视频《一家公司如何秘密毒害地球》中，穆勒深入探讨了PFAS的危害，该视频时长近一小时，发布一天内就获得近300万观看。视频不仅揭露了企业不当行为，还详细解释了这些“永久化学品”对人类的危害。穆勒在科学教育和影视制作之间曾面临职业选择，最终通过Veritasium实现了将两者结合的独特价值。他的视频强调了困惑和挑战在学习中的重要性，并通过自己的例子警示公众关注PFAS污染这一紧迫健康问题。
44123945.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：PFAS化学物质的危害及相关企业和机构的责任

不同观点：
• [Neywiny] 认为电影《Dark Waters》揭示了PFAS问题，尤其是对无辜受害者的影响。该评论强调了电影在提高公众对PFAS危害认识方面的作用，并对那些在抗争中失败的人表示关注。

• [chiph] 提到因为了解到微波爆米花袋内涂层会释放PFAS化学物质，已改回使用炉灶制作爆米花。他对PFAS化学物质的释放机制有疑问，不确定这些化学物质是在货架上释放还是在微波加热时释放。他还引用了视频链接以支持其观点。

• [nullc] 的评论简短且带有讽刺意味，表示对问题解决不抱希望，可能暗示对当前情况的无能为力或失望。

• [bluesounddirect] 提供了一个存档链接，可能与讨论的主题相关，但没有详细阐述自己的观点。

• [more_corn] 批评了企业（如3M）在PFAS问题上长达数十年的隐瞒行为，并对公共机构在保护公众免受PFAS危害方面的无所作为表示愤怒。评论强调了3M公司在问题曝光后的宽恕以及机构在规则撤销方面的失职。

补充讨论：
• PFAS化学物质的来源和释放机制是讨论中的一个重要问题，尤其是[chiph]提出的微波爆米花袋涂层问题及其具体释放方式。
• 企业和公共机构在PFAS问题上的责任和失职是另一个讨论焦点，[more_corn]特别强调了公司隐瞒行为和机构不作为对公众健康的威胁。
• 电影《Dark Waters》在提高公众意识方面的作用被[Neywiny]视为积极的，但其他评论更关注实际问题的解决和责任追究。

争议焦点：企业和公共机构在PFAS问题上的责任及公众如何获得有效保护。

data.title: Cory Doctorow on how we lost the internet
data.author: udev4096
data.article_summary: Cory Doctorow在PyCon US 2025上发表主题演讲，讨论当今互联网的衰退，即"enshittification"（腐化）过程。他将其分为三个阶段：首先，平台通过提升用户体验来吸引用户，同时设法锁定用户；接着，在用户难以离开时，平台开始牺牲用户体验以取悦商业客户，如增加广告；最后，平台价值被榨取到仅剩最低限度以维持用户和商业客户的依赖。他以Google为例，说明其通过锁定用户和操控广告市场来实现增长，甚至通过非法合作（如"Jedi Blue"项目）操控广告市场，最终导致搜索质量下降，用户和商业客户都受到负面影响。Doctorow强调，这种腐化也体现在其他行业，如护理工作通过类似"Uber for nursing"的应用程序剥削护士。他呼吁关注这种系统性问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对Doctorow的演讲和其对互联网问题的分析的评价，以及进一步资源推荐。

不同观点：
• [freedomben] 认为Doctorow对问题的分析非常具有说服力，无论是否同意他提出的解决方案。该评论者赞赏演讲和相关文章，并提供了进一步观看演讲的链接。同时，他还推荐了Doctorow的书《The Internet Con: How to Seize the Means of Computation》作为深入理解的资源。

• [ChrisArchitect] 则指出该话题在之前已被讨论过，并提供了一个先前讨论的链接。这个评论似乎暗示可能没有必要再次讨论同一话题，或建议读者参考先前的讨论以获取更多信息。

补充讨论：
• 评论之间存在一定的讨论关系，[ChrisArchitect]通过提供先前讨论的链接，引导读者查看其他地方的相似话题，从而可能减少重复讨论。

Cory Doctorow on how we lost the internet
[LWN subscriber-only content]
Welcome to LWN.net
The following subscription-only content has been made available to you
by an LWN subscriber.  Thousands of subscribers depend on LWN for the
best news from the Linux and free software communities.  If you enjoy this
article, please consider
subscribing to LWN
.  Thank you
for visiting LWN.net!
By
Jake Edge
May 27, 2025
PyCon US
Cory Doctorow
wears many hats
:
digital activist, science-fiction author, journalist, and more.  He has
also written many books, both fiction and non-fiction, runs the
Pluralistic blog
, is a visiting
professor, and is an advisor to the
Electronic
Frontier Foundation
(EFF); his
Chokepoint Capitalism
co-author, Rebecca Giblin, gave a
2023 keynote
in Australia
that we covered.  Doctorow gave a rousing keynote on
the state of the "enshitternet"—today's internet—to kick
off the recently held
PyCon US
2025
in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
He began by noting that he is known for coining the term
"
enshittification
" about the decay of tech platforms, so attendees were
probably expecting to hear about that; instead, he wanted to start by
talking about nursing.  A
recent
study
described how nurses are increasingly getting work through one of
three main apps that "
bill themselves out as 'Uber for nursing'
".
The nurses never know what they will be paid per hour prior to accepting a
shift and the three companies act as a cartel in order to "
play all
kinds of games with the way that labor is priced
".
In particular, the
companies purchase financial information from a data broker before offering
a nurse a shift; if the nurse is carrying a lot of credit-card debt,
especially if some of that is delinquent, the amount offered is
reduced. "
Because, the more desperate you are, the less you'll accept to
come into work and do that grunt work of caring for the sick, the elderly,
and the dying.
"  That is horrific on many levels, he said, but "
it
is emblematic of 'enshittification'
", which is one of the reasons he
highlighted it.
Platform decay
Enshittification is a three-stage process; he used Google to
illustrate the idea.  At first, Google minimized ads and maximized spending
on engineering to produce a great search engine; while it was doing that,
however, it was buying its way to dominance. "
They bribed every service,
every product
that had a search box to make sure that that was a Google search box.
"
No matter which browser, phone carrier, or operating system you were using,
Google ensured that you were using its search by default; by the early
2020s, it was spending the equivalent of buying a Twitter every 18 months
to do so, he said.  That is the first stage of the process: when the
provider is being good to its users, but is finding ways to lock them in.
The second phase occurs once the company recognizes that it has users
locked in, so it will be difficult for them to switch away, and it shifts
to making things worse for its users in order to enrich its business
customers.  For Google, those are the publishers and advertisers.  A
growing portion of the search results page is shifted over to ads
"
marked off with ever-subtler, ever-smaller, ever-grayer labels
distinguishing them from the organic search results
".  While the
platform is getting better for business customers—at the expense of the
users—those customers are also getting locked in.
Phase three of enshittification is when the value of the platform is
clawed back until all that is left is kind of a "
homeopathic residue—the
least value needed to keep both business customers and end users locked to
the platform
".  We have gained a view into this process from the three
monopoly cases that Google has lost over the last 18 months. In 2019, the
company had 90% of the world's search traffic and its users were loyal;
"
everyone who searched on Google, searched everything on Google
".
But that meant that Google's search growth had plateaued, so how was the
company going to be able to grow?  It could "
raise a billion humans to
adulthood and make them Google customers, which is
Google Classroom
, but that's a
slow process
".  From the internal memos that came to light from the
court cases, we can see what the company chose to do, he said: "
they
made search worse
".
The accuracy of the search results was reduced, which meant that users
needed to do two or three queries to the get the results they would have
seen on the first page.  That increased the number of ads that could be
shown, which is obviously bad for searchers, but the company was also
attacking its business customers at the same time.  For example, "
Google entered into
an illegal, collusive arrangement with Meta, called
Jedi Blue
" that
"
gamed the advertising market
"
