data.title: Invading the Huum Uku WiFi Controller
data.author: hddherman
data.article_summary:
本文主要讲述了作者在寻找拥有桑拿房的房产过程中，对桑拿控制器的远程控制功能产生了兴趣。然而，由于该控制器依赖于Huum的专有云服务，而作者不愿使用无法本地控制的智能设备，因此决定自行研究如何实现本地控制。作者计划通过网络流量分析来了解控制器与云端的通信方式，并尝试破解其通信协议。

作者首先设置笔记本电脑作为热点，以隔离控制器流量并进行中间人攻击（MITM）分析。通过使用Wireshark和mitmproxy工具，作者成功捕获了一些未加密的通信数据，并识别出一些与温度传感器和加热控制相关的数据包。例如，作者发现控制器每隔约4分钟发送一次11字节的消息，并通过分析数据包内容推断出一些字节的可能含义，如指示消息类型和温度设置。

尽管取得了一些进展，作者仍面临TLS加密等挑战，且目前的研究多为推测和实验，尚未实际实现远程控制功能。作者计划继续分析通信数据，以期最终能够本地控制桑拿房的加热系统。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Huum集成和API设计中的问题及其实际影响

不同观点：
• **frwickst的观点**：作为pyhuum库和Huum集成的开发者，他指出当前API设计存在缺陷。具体来说，API在桑拿关闭时不返回设定值和目标值，尽管这些数据实际上是可以获取的。他提到，这是为了避免频繁请求，但通过两次请求（检查状态和获取关闭时的值）可以绕过此问题。然而，这种方法会导致桑拿状态更新不及时，从而引发意外行为，特别是在与Home Assistant结合使用时。

• **protocolture的观点**：分享了自己尝试控制LED灯的类似经历。他发送TCP数据包后，设备似乎进入了bootloader模式，导致设备无法正常启动。这表明一些设备可能缺乏足够的保护机制来防止误操作。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现问题**：frwickst详细描述了API设计中的具体问题及其对用户体验的影响，尤其是与Home Assistant结合使用时的问题。
• **设备脆弱性**：protocolture的经历强调了某些设备在处理不当命令时可能存在的脆弱性，这与frwickst讨论的技术问题形成对比，但都指向了物联网设备和API设计中需要改进的方面。
• **解决方案和协作**：frwickst表示愿意帮助检查和改进Huum的集成问题，表明社区协作可能是解决这些技术挑战的重要途径。

44103923.article_content:
I like saunas. For those unfamiliar with the concept, it is a hot room where you are occasionally beaten with
tree-branches.
You might have seen images like this:
While in reality it is often more like this
Anyway, while looking for my very own financial burden to call home, I stumbled upon an offering which heavily promoted
the fact that it had a sauna.
Neat! Then I found out it had a
remote capable controller
. Even neater! The
only issue is that it uses Huum’s proprietary cloud to do the remote controlling. And I very much dislike that. I mean
it is fine for normal people, but I will not use any smartness on any device that I cannot control locally.
But having remote control would still be nice, wouldn’t it?
I’ve been thinking about this on-and-off for over a year now. It’d be oh so nice to arrive home from shit weather and be
able to hop into a sauna that has already done the 1.5 hour long heat to 90 degrees.
Theory
#
Searching the web I found that there’s an
official-ish Home Assistant
integration for Huum, but it requires logging in with the Huum app before use and basically only replicates the API
calls the mobile app does. The integration seems to be built around the
pyhuum
library.
But I don’t like that. I want my HA to control the controller directly.
So I need to figure out how the controller speaks with the cloud. Or how the cloud speaks with the controller? In both
cases the Controller has to be the one initiating the connection as otherwise I would have to allow the outside
connection through the firewall. Which I have not (and will not) do. It is way too complicated for a regular person
anyway.
After consulting ChatGPT, we arrived at a solution: I was to use port mirroring on my switch to direct all the traffic
generated main module to my laptop, where it could be Wiresharked. Crap, it doesn’t do eth, only Wi-Fi. (Uku
WiFi
…).
I then had the idea of setting my laptop up as a hotspot to connect the controller to. Firstly, it isolates the
controller traffic from the rest of my home stuffs, and secondly, it should allow me to MITM the communication.
These are
my
devices in
my
network!
Basically, the plan is to use my laptop’s hotspot to sniff traffic between the controller and a known API endpoint
https://api.huum.eu/action/
.
After writing the previous sentence, two thoughts occurred - the first one is that this is the endpoint receiving
commands from the mobile app, but it is not necessarily the one sending commands to my controller. And the second one is
that if TLS is in play (
which I damn hope is the case
), I won’t have access to the request payloads. But you see,
request payloads sound like the juicy bits of this ordeal.
Third thought, actually, what if the controller opens a websocket to the cloud? How do I sniff traffic then? I have no
experience with websockets…
Ehh, one step at a time.
Gebedee proposes
mitmproxy
to listen in on the TLS payloads. The docs seem simple enough.
Also, bear in mind that up until this point I’ve not yet actually done anything. The above is pure speculation and
research.
Looking into the traffic
#
So, I’ve set up a hotspot using NetworkManager on my laptop, and am using a wired connection to retain world-wide-web
capabilities.
After about 3 hours of wiresharking and looking for ways to read TLS encrypted messages, I stumbled upon a TCP frame
with the following payload:
1
0b9900ac68b59c000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000005551342d342d322e322e313231332d34613164366461312d340000000000555134204555205769466900000000
Now, it might not seem much, but Wireshark also shows the payload converted to ASCII
UQ4-4-2.2.1213-4a1d6da1-4
and
UQ4 EU WiFi
? That’s not TLS-ed at all! When checking the controller info menu, they
seem to be the firmware version and controller’s friendly name. Cool!
Looking more at the traffic, every 4-ish minutes the controller seems to say something in 11 bytes. The red box is the
previous handshake.
Payload of those messages is always
09 17 00 f8 23 00 00 00 00 00 00
. The only thing I’ve managed to decode from this
thus far is the reading from the sauna’s temperature sensor - the second byte
17
seems to indicate the current reading
form the temperature sensor at 23 degees.
The first byte of
09
is likely either message type, or some framing byte.
Let’s try turning the sauna on by pressing the button on the controller. I powered on the heater, counted to 20
Mipsipipi
, and powered it off again.
First packet to the server at 14:48:36
08 5a 00 00 00 00 03 11 6c 2c 68 41 96 2c 68 13 6c 2c 68 00 00 00 00 01 00
and a second “turn off” packet at 14:49:03
08 5a 00 00 00 00 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 2e 6c 2c 68 00 00 00 00 01 00
27 seconds apart… close enough.
My idea of the payload contents - byte
08
indicates a “heater control” message.
5a
indicates target temp of
90
degrees (I did indeed set target to 90), and then there’s some unknown crap. There are also some groups that look like
timestamps:
“Heater on” message:
Hex (little endian)
Dec

data.title: High vitamin B6 doses over a long period could cause irreversible nerve damage
data.author: l8rlump
data.article_summary: 文章报道了过量摄入维生素B6可能导致不可逆的神经损伤，尤其是引发周围神经病变。自2020年以来，澳大利亚治疗用品管理局（TGA）已收到119起相关报告。76岁的退休医生Mary Buchanan因长期服用含高剂量维生素B6的镁补充剂，出现腿部无力、疼痛等症状，最终被诊断为维生素B6中毒。她体内的维生素B6水平是正常值的七倍，导致神经损伤。专家警告，只有经确认缺乏维生素B6的人才需要补充，普通人无需额外摄入。目前，监管机构正考虑加强对B6产品的管控，可能要求其置于柜台后销售。文章提醒公众警惕补充剂中的成分，并在使用前咨询专业人士。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：维生素B6的过量摄入及其对健康的影响

不同观点：
• **pelorat**：分享了自身经历，由于长期饮用能量饮料和服用多维生素补充剂，导致B6过量，出现多汗、皮肤脱落和触觉减退等症状。他认为过量的B6损害了皮肤下的神经末梢，导致触觉减退和出汗减少。他提醒大家避免过量摄入维生素补充剂和能量饮料。

• **gloxkiqcza**：引用了澳大利亚Therapeutic Goods Administration的报告，指出B6毒性的病例在低至21毫克每天的剂量下就有报道，而推荐的每日摄入量为1.3至2毫克。强调了长期摄入可能导致的健康问题。

• **viraptor**：指出很多病例没有明确记录摄入量，有些病例涉及500毫克以上的摄入量。最初的阈值设定是基于"未发现低于500毫克的问题，所以设定为一半即250毫克"。提到如果摄入超过100毫克，血清水平会超出常规实验室的范围。

• **MassPikeMike**：分享了相反的经历，B6对他的神经痛有积极效果。他由于职业原因导致严重的神经痛，通过服用50毫克B6得以缓解。他提到研究表明问题通常出现在摄入200毫克以上的人群中，并质疑是否有人研究过B6对类似病例的积极效果。

• **Havoc**：检查了自己购买的补充剂，发现有长期使用可能导致刺痛和麻木的警告，决定不再使用。对补充剂的安全性感到担忧。

• **Elaris**：对维生素补充剂的潜在风险感到惊讶，强调了补充剂给人的虚假安全感。指出不同人对B6的反应差异很大，有人受益，有人受损，提醒大家不要盲目认为越多越好。

• **antman**：建议通过血液检测确定维生素、矿物质和酶的水平，只补充必要的东西。对一般维生素补充持谨慎态度。

• **Aziell**：之前未意识到B6的副作用，阅读讨论后了解到长期过量摄入可能损害神经，且可能不可逆。

Warnings high doses of vitamin B6 over a long period could cause irreversible nerve damage
By Tom Hartley
7.30
Topic:
Health
Wed 8 Jan
Wednesday 8 January
Wed 8 Jan 2025 at 7:36am
Loading...
In short:
Since 2020, the TGA has received 119 reports relating to peripheral neuropathy as a result of vitamin B6 poisoning.
Vitamin B6 is commonly available without a prescription but only those with confirmed deficiencies are required to take a supplement.
What's next:
The regulatory body is now considering an application to require B6 products to be stored behind the counter.
abc.net.au/news/vitamin-b6-toxicity-peripheral-neuropathy-health-supplements/104793006
Link copied
Share
Share
article
An over-the-counter supplement has ruined Dr Mary Buchanan's mobility and sense of freedom.
The 76-year-old spent four decades on her feet as an emergency physician.
Now in retirement, she struggles to walk short distances, up stairs or hills, suffering pain in her legs with depleted muscle strength and fatigue.
"It's changed my life in the way that my mobility has certainly been affected," Dr Buchanan told 7.30.
"That's not the sort of future I really want for myself, that I might be dependent on people before I may have needed to be."
The root cause of her debilitation has been traced to vitamin B6.
Vitamin B6 is vital for cognitive function but very few Australians are deficient in it.
(
ABC News: Jerry Rickard
)
The vitamin is present in thousands of products in Australia as an additive — including medicines, multivitamin and mineral supplements, energy drinks and weight loss shakes — that is commonly available without a prescription and sold in supermarkets, health food shops, pharmacies, and online.
B6 is vital to cognitive function and only those with confirmed deficiencies are required to take a supplement.
In Dr Buchanan's case, she consumed it unknowingly.
B6 was one of the ingredients in a magnesium supplement she started taking in 2021 called 'Muscleze', a BioCeuticals product by Blackmores.
It was recommended to her by her pharmacist to help treat a genetic condition that gave her unbearable leg cramps and sleepless nights.
Dr Mary Buchanan began taking a magnesium supplement which also contained vitamin B6 in 2021.
(
ABC News
)
After a few weeks, the daily doses appeared to be working.
Relief came. The leg twitching eased and sleep followed.
But then it went backwards, as if a mystery illness had taken over her body.
"Gradually over time, I sort of thought, 'Oh my gosh, I'm getting a bit weak, my legs seem to be getting weaker,'" Dr Buchanan said.
It got so bad, she feared she had Multiple Sclerosis or Motor Neurone Disease.
"The weakness continued so much so that I was having trouble going up, up and down stairs, and I could hardly walk 100 metres,"
she said.
"And so I thought I probably have got something quite nasty, neurologically."
B6 toxicity
In March 2023, after two years of routinely taking the supplement, a neurologist diagnosed her with peripheral neuropathy, the result of vitamin B6 toxicity.
Cases of vitamin B6 poisoning are potentially very dangerous.
(
ABC News
)
Tests revealed she had seven times the normal level of the vitamin in her system, which had damaged the nerve endings in her legs.
"I'd never heard of [B6 toxicity], my colleagues had never heard of it, my GP hadn't heard of it," Dr Buchanan told 7.30.
Dr Buchanan wrongly believed that the excess vitamin would be excreted from her system, but manufactured Vitamin B6 can survive in the body for up to 30 days.
"It was able to store in the neurological cells in my legs, and that caused irrecoverable damage to the nerves and also then to the muscles,"
she said.
"I did feel angry when I looked at the literature and found there's no particular reason why B6 is combined with magnesium.
"People have got to be very wary of what is in supplementary medicines."
In a statement to 7.30 BioCeuticals said its B6 products "meet the stringent regulatory requirements of the TGA" and while it notes "adverse reactions can happen", it thoroughly investigates and addresses any reports raised.
"Consumers should consult their healthcare professional before taking multiple products containing vitamin B6," it said.
Dr Buchanan told 7.30 'Muscleze' was the only supplement she was taking.
'Tip of the iceberg'
The Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) regulates supplements distributed in Australia and monitors side effects from approved products.
Since 2020 the body has received 119 reports related to vitamin B6 and peripheral neuropathy.
Health professionals suspect many more cases have gone unreported.
Senior Neurologist Professor Tissa Wijeratne is the chair of the World Federation of Neurology and believes these numbers are "just the tip of the iceberg."
Professor Tissa Wijeratne warned that peripheral neuropathy can have debilitating effects.
(
Supplied
)

data.title: U.S. Woman Dies from Mad Cow-Like Brain Disease That Lay Dormant for 50 Years
data.author: Vaslo
data.article_summary: 这篇文章报道了一名58岁女性因克雅氏病（CJD）去世，该病可能源于她童年时接受的受污染的人体生长激素（HGH）治疗。这是迄今记录的最长的潜伏期，约为50年。朊病毒是一种异常的致病蛋白，能够导致如CJD等致命疾病，且具有极强的抗消毒能力。虽然朊病毒疾病非常罕见，但通过医疗手段（如HGH）或食用受感染的牛肉（如疯牛病）仍可能传播。文章提醒医生注意这类延迟发作的病例，特别是患者曾在1977年前接受HGH治疗的历史。全球已有超过200例因受污染HGH导致的医源性CJD病例报告。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过受污染的医疗产品或血液传播的朊病毒疾病（如克雅氏病）的潜在风险，以及这些疾病的潜伏期和影响。

不同观点：
• [toomuchtodo] 分享了一篇关于长期潜伏期的克雅氏病病例的论文，强调了使用受污染的人类生长激素可能导致的疾病风险。
• [KingMob] 提到1990年代的“疯牛病”事件，指出由于动物寿命与疾病发作时间相符，人类感染的真实情况可能需要几十年后才能完全了解。
• [danpalmer] 指出全球对献血的限制，尤其是基于地理和时间段的献血限制，例如在英国90年代接受过输血的人在澳大利亚无法献血。
• [dwroberts] 强调了通过受污染的人类生长激素感染克雅氏病的具体背景，以帮助不点击链接的人理解。
• [topher515] 提到了一本关于朊病毒疾病的书，尽管缺少最新研究，但仍具有很高的阅读价值。
• [JauntTrooper] 对疾病的长时间潜伏期表示好奇，质疑其是缓慢进展还是随着年龄增长而 opportunistically 发作。
• [tehlike] 强调朊病毒疾病是“噩梦般的燃料”，指出阿尔茨海默病等疾病同样无法治愈且可能长时间潜伏。
• [burnt-resistor] 指出最常见的朊病毒疾病形式是自发性的CJD，不需要受污染的食物或医疗产品，蛋白质的自发性错误折叠即可引发。
• [AStonesThrow] 以幽默方式提到可以在家“折叠朊病毒”，引用了分布式计算项目Folding@home。
• [SubiculumCode] 猜测是否可能再次使朊病毒进入休眠状态。
• [Tjerkienator] 提出疑问，是否所有患有痴呆并在诊断后不久去世的人都是疯牛病的受害者。
• [gsf_emergency] 分享了关于疫苗的成功案例，提供了一些希望，以缓解对朊病毒疾病的恐惧。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于朊病毒疾病的潜伏期和不可预测性，以及是否所有痴呆症病例都可能与外部因素如疯牛病有关。
• 讨论中还提到了对血液捐献的限制和历史事件对现代医疗实践的影响。
• 有人关注朊病毒疾病的自发性和不可控性，强调了这些疾病的“噩梦”性质和缺乏治愈方法的现状。

By
Ed Cara
Published May 16, 2025
|
Comments (
19

ð
Copied!
A 3D illustration of prions, which contain no genetic material but can spread and cause diseases like other germs.
Â© Love Employee via Getty
The grim reaper can sometimes take decades to catch up with its victims. In a report out this week, scientists describe a woman who died from an incurable prion disease caught roughly 50 years earlier.
Doctors detailed the unusual case in a paper
published
Wednesday in the journal Emerging Infectious Diseases. The 58-year-old woman developed a form of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (CJD) likely contracted through contaminated human growth hormone (HGH) treatments she received as a child, they determined. The tragic death may represent the longest latency period ever documented for this universally fatal disease.
Disease-causing prions are one of the strangest things that can sicken people. They’re the misfolded form of the normal (but still very mysterious) prion protein found in our bodies and brains. When a rogue prion comes across its harmless counterpart, it converts the latter into a misfolded copy of itself, much like a zombie outbreak.
A Mad Cow-Like Prion Disease Has Killed Two People and Sickened a Third in Same Oregon Town
Over time, the exponential accumulation of bad prions destroys the brain, leading to symptoms like dementia and death soon after. If that’s not scary enough, prions are naturally resistant to most standard methods of sterilization used to kill off other infectious agents like bacteria or viruses. The one saving grace is that prion diseases in general remain very rare, though other prion-like diseases like
Alzheimer’s
are more common.
Prions can emerge sporadically for no clear reason, can be caused by inherited mutations, or they can be transmitted though close contact with infected bodily fluids or brain matter. In the 1980s, for instance, doctors discovered that people could catch CJD through human growth hormone extracted from prion-infected cadavers. A decade later, we learned that people could also catch CJD via tainted beef from cows infected with their own version of prion disease (nicknamed mad cow disease).
The discovery of HGH-related CJD quickly led to the end of cadaver-sourced HGH in the U.S. and other countries (thankfully, synthetic HGH became available soon after). Still, over two hundred cases of iatrogenic CJDâiatrogenic meaning it was caused by a medical treatmentâfrom tainted HGH have been documented worldwide. Most of these cases were reported between five and 10 years after people had used HGH. But prion disease can sometimes take much longer to manifest in certain people, even decades.
According to this latest report, the woman first visited doctors with tremors and trouble balancing. As is often the case, once symptoms started, her condition rapidly worsened. She was hospitalized just four weeks later, and several days into her stay, she fell into a coma that she would never awaken from.
An autopsy confirmed the woman’s death from CJD but ruled out known genetic causes. And since she received HGH treatment prior to the cadaver ban, it was likely the root source of her illness, the doctors concluded.
What Ever Happened to Mad Cow?
HGH is used to treat severe growth-related conditions in children, and is typically taken over many years, including in this case. That makes it impossible to know exactly when the woman contracted CJD. Her first treatment was 51.3 years prior to her symptoms appearing, for instance, while her last treatment was 42.1 years earlier. But the U.S. switched to a different method of collecting HGH from cadavers in 1977, one that inadvertently and greatly reduced the risk of prion contamination. Based on that, the most likely timeframe for her infection is around 48.3 years earlier, the authors calculated.
There are known cases of people dying from CJD infections caught over
30 years ago
, as well as
reports
of other prion diseases emerging over a half century later. But this appears to be the longest case of HGH-related CJD documented so far, though it might not be the last.
The researchers note that genetics can influence a person’s chances of developing prion disease. And the woman possessed a mutation in the gene that codes for the prion protein linked to longer latency periods. So while tainted human growth hormone hasn’t caused CJD for a very long time, some people out there may still one day succumb to their earlier exposure (it’s estimated that around 7,700 people in the U.S. took HGH prior to the cadaver ban).
The authors say that doctors treating neurological illness should at least be on the lookout for these delayed cases, especially if their patients have a history of HGH treatment before 1977.
“Although the US iCJD outbreak has slowed substantially, the potential for new cases remains,” they wrote.

data.title: SpaceX town residents may lose right to using their property for its current use
data.article_summary: Starbase, Texas（前称Boca Chica Village）是埃隆·马斯克的SpaceX公司所在地，正考虑一项新的分区条例和全市地图。市政府通知当地居民，他们可能会失去继续以当前方式使用其财产的权利，特别是在拟议的“混合用途区”内。该区域将允许住宅、办公、零售和小规模服务设施。市政府计划于6月23日举行公开听证会讨论新分区条例和城市地图。Starbase于本月正式成立，由SpaceX员工和前员工管理，旨在为公司提供更多建造和发射火箭的自由。目前，该镇人口约500人，其中260人直接受雇于SpaceX。

Elon Musk
's
SpaceX
, is considering a new zoning ordinance and citywide map.
The notice, sent to property owners in a proposed "Mixed Use District," would allow for "residential, office, retail, and small-scale service uses."
Starbase plans to host a public hearing on June 23 about the proposed new zoning and map for the town. The notice was signed by Kent Myers, the
city administrator
for Starbase who recently accepted the job, according to
ValleyCentral.com
.

municipal corporation
," Starbase was officially formed earlier this month after Musk's aerospace and defense contractor prevailed in a local election. It is now run by officials who are SpaceX employees and former employees.

population
of Starbase stood at around 500 people, with around 260 directly
employed
by SpaceX, the Texas Tribune reported. Most other residents of Starbase are relatives of SpaceX employees.
The company town includes the launch facility where SpaceX conducts test flights of its massive Starship rocket, and company-owned land covering a 1.6-square-mile area.

The rocket

The FAA said there had been "no reports of public injury or damage to public property" on Wednesday.
The Starship system was developed to transport people and equipment around Earth and to the Moon, and Musk envisions the rocket someday being used to colonize Mars.

The town is still trying to win the ability to close a main road and beaches for

《Mac浏览器Arc将停运，转向新应用Dia》  
作者Ben Lovejoy，2025年5月27日  
Arc是一款旨在重塑浏览器体验的Mac应用，目标是打造更个性化和易用的“互联网计算机”。然而，发布不到两年，公司宣布将停运Arc，转向新应用Dia，后者被视为未来互联网使用的方向。尽管Arc拥有一批忠实用户，但因学习曲线陡峭、功能过于复杂，未能广泛普及。公司CEO Josh Miller解释，Arc的许多核心功能仅被少数用户使用，因此决定从零开始开发更简单的Dia。Arc不会开源，而Dia目前处于alpha测试阶段，将向Arc用户开放。Miller认为Dia将适应以AI为主的未来网络世界。

补充讨论：

• 对浏览器创新和用户适应性的讨论：pawanjswal 的评论反映出用户对浏览器创新的渴望与适应新工具之间的矛盾。一方面，用户希望看到创新的浏览体验，但另一方面，适应新工具需要时间和精力，这可能导致用户对频繁变动的抵触。

• Arc 浏览器的 sunset 决定是否合理：部分用户可能认为 Arc 浏览器的结束是合理的，特别是如果他们认为其学习曲线影响了使用体验；而像 pawanjswal 这样的用户则对其创新性表示认可，并对其结束感到失望。

44132815.article_content:
Apps
Mac
Mac browser Arc being discontinued in favor of new Dia app
Ben Lovejoy
| May 27 2025 - 4:53 am PT
24 Comments
The
Mac
app
Arc
set out to re-invent the web browser as an “internet computer” app – something which felt more personal and usable than mainstream browsers.
Less than two years later, the company has announced that it’s discontinuing Arc in favor of a new app – Dia – which it is
also
pitching as the future of internet usage …
Arc may not have challenged the market leaders like Chrome and Safari, but it had generated a loyal and enthusiastic user base on the Mac. The company’s original goal seemed very much in line with the Mac ethos.
We wanted to build something that felt like “your home on the internet” — for work projects, personal life, all the hours you spent in your browser every single day. Something that felt more like a product from Nintendo or Disney than from a browser vendor. Something with taste, care, feeling.
We wanted you to open Arc every morning and think, “This is mine, my space.” And we called this north star vision the “Internet Computer.”
Given the company saw Arc as the future of internet access, it surprised many when it started work on a new app with essentially the same goal, Dia. What will likely come as an even bigger surprise – and disappointment – is that Arc is now being discontinued.
The company’s CEO Josh Miller has today written
a lengthy open letter
explaining the decision. He said that Arc hadn’t taken off in the way the company hoped, in large part because it had a steep initial learning curve.
A lot of people loved Arc — if you’re here you might just be one of them — and we’d benefitted from consistent, organic growth since basically Day One. But for most people, Arc was simply too different, with too many new things to learn, for too little reward.
That in turn was because it tried to do too much. Many things the company had seen as core features were only used by a tiny minority of users.
Top comment by
Tom
Liked by 4 people
Where in the open letter does it say the Mac app is being discontinued? As far as I can read, they’re still doing maintenance updates, as they have been doing for months.
im a fan: I switched to Arc from Safari only 2 months ago. To my surprise it is much faster and the interface is great. If not briliant.
Safari on the other hand has become a bloated mess. I don’t understand it anymore: profiles, tab groups, favorities, iCloud tabs, … I get lost in the interface. Especially as it’s different on iPhone, iPad and macOS.
View all comments
While it could have tried to turn Arc into a more accessible app, Miller said they ultimately decided that if you want to a truly simple product, you have to start from scratch. That’s why it’s now focusing exclusively on Dia.
Early on, Scott Forstall told us Arc felt like a saxophone — powerful but hard to learn. Then he challenged us: make it a piano. Something anyone can sit down at and play. This is now the idea behind Dia: hide complexity behind familiar interfaces […]
[Simplicity, speed, and security] are all things that need to be part of a product’s foundation. Not afterthoughts. As we pushed the boundaries of whether this truly was Arc 2.0 last summer, we found that there were shortcomings in Arc that were too large to tackle retroactively, and that building a new type of software (and fast) required a new type of foundation.
Sadly, it won’t be open-sourcing Arc to allow others to continue to develop it. Miller says this is because Arc was built on a development kit that is the company’s “secret sauce,” and it can’t open-source ADK without doing the same with that.
Dia is designed for what Miller sees as a new world which will be AI agent first, web second (shades here of
another view expressed today
). The app is currently in alpha-testing, and will open next to Arc members. You can
read the full letter here
.

主要讨论点：对AI应用及其潜在影响的讨论，包括对政府使用AI的质疑、AI生成内容的可靠性、以及AI对社会和领导层的影响。

不同观点：
• [mola] 认为当前的AI浪潮不会仅仅带来生产力的提升，反而可能导致大规模的混乱，尤其是那些不采用AI的国家可能在人口智力和能力上占据优势。领导层可能因为依赖AI而显得愚钝，且那些不采用AI的国家将获得优势。

• [aorloff] 以讽刺的语气回应，暗示对政府（特别是巴西相关新闻）使用AI可能带来的错误表示担忧，并提到繁琐的行政程序（如填写投诉表格）。

• [Animats] 建议通过信息自由法案（FOIA）请求获取政府使用的AI提示词，或通过国会委员会进行调查，以增加透明度。

• [mikestew] 提供了一个存档链接，可能与讨论中的文章或信息相关。

• [llacb47] 指出白宫否认使用AI，但怀疑其真实性，暗示政府可能在说谎。

• [otherayden] 提供了一个链接，可能与讨论中的健康或科学文章相关。

• [duxup] 以讽刺的方式表示，即使是做糟糕的工作，这些人也做不好，暗示对当前某些机构能力的不满。

• [kcaseg] 提到一个关于气候变化的AI研究，指出问题不在于小的引用错误，而在于LLM（大型语言模型）倾向于迎合用户的观点，即使提示被认为是中立的。

• [caseysoftware] 提出不应引用不存在、不可复制或包含假数据的研究，建议对违规者进行惩罚。

• [platevoltage] 开玩笑地建议在提示词中加入“不包含引用”，以解决引用问题。

• [esalman] 提到一系列政府错误，包括虚假的关税方程和当前的AI问题，表示遗憾没有称职的人愿意与当前的政府合作。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于政府使用AI的透明度和可靠性，尤其是是否存在隐瞒使用AI的情况。
• 对AI生成内容（如研究报告）的引用和数据真实性的担忧。
• 对领导层依赖AI可能导致的智力下降和社会混乱的担忧。
• 对政府机构能力的普遍不满和不信任。

data.article_summary: Hugging Face推出了两款开源人形机器人HopeJR和Reachy Mini，继续进军机器人领域。HopeJR是一个拥有66个自由度的大型机器人，能够行走和操作物体，成本低于3000美元。Reachy Mini是一个桌面型机器人，能够转头、说话和聆听，适合测试AI应用，价格在250至300美元之间。这些机器人旨在降低机器人技术的入门门槛，确保系统透明且价格亲民。Hugging Face预计将在年底前开始发货，并通过收购Pollen Robotics获得了开发这些机器人的能力。此前，Hugging Face还发布了LeRobot平台和更新版的SO-101机械臂。

44132594.article_content:
AI dev platform
Hugging Face
continued its push into robotics on Thursday with the release of two new humanoid robots.
The company announced a pair of open source robots, HopeJR and Reachy Mini. HopeJR is a full-size humanoid robot that has 66 actuated degrees of freedom, or 66 independent movements, including the ability to walk and move its arms. Reachy Mini is a desktop unit that can move its head, talk, listen, and be used to test AI apps.
Meet HopeJr, a full humanoid robot lowering the barrier to entry!
Capable of walking, manipulating many objects, open-source and costs under $3000 🤯
Designed by
@therobotstudio
and
@huggingface
👇
pic.twitter.com/wCwo8YPOGV
— Remi Cadene (@RemiCadene)
May 29, 2025
Hugging Face doesn’t have an exact timeline for shipping these robots. The company’s co-founder and CEO, Clem Delangue, told TechCrunch over email that they expect to start shipping at least the first few units by the end of the year, and the waitlist is currently open.
Reachy Mini Credit: Hugging Face
Hugging Face estimates that the HopeJR will cost around $3,000 per unit and the Reachy Mini will cost around $250 to $300, depending on tariffs.
“The important aspect is that these robots are open source, so anyone can assemble, rebuild, [and] understand how they work, and [that they’re] affordable, so that robotics doesn’t get dominated by just a few big players with dangerous black-box systems,” Delangue said via email.
This robot release was made possible in part by the company’s acquisition of humanoid robotics startup
Pollen Robotics
, which was announced in April, according to Delangue. He added that the Pollen team gave Hugging Face “new capabilities” required to make these bots.
Hugging Face has been making a concerted push into the robotics industry over the past few years. It launched
LeRobot
, a collection of open AI models, datasets, and tools to build robotics systems, in 2024.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕一家科学和 surplus 商店（American Science and Surplus）的情感和经历分享，以及对其现状和未来发展的讨论。

不同观点：
• [积极支持] onetimeusename、semiquaver、RickS、beatboxrevival、ryangittins 等人对该商店表示高度赞赏。他们分享了个人经历，包括在科学项目中获得的帮助、独特的购物体验以及对商店独特商品的喜爱。特别提到该商店在启发和支持创意项目中的作用，并表示愿意捐款支持其继续运营。

• [批评与担忧] os2warpman、uxp100 等人对商店的现状表示失望。他们认为商店的重点已经从科学和surplus商品转移到了消费品和劣质商品。os2warpman 特别指出，过去的商品种类更丰富，质量更高，而现在可选商品减少且质量下降。uxp100 还对比了其他类似但更有趣的商店，如Weird Stuff Warehouse。

• [怀旧与惋惜] blooalien、cmcconomy、MaDeuce 等人分享了他们对类似商店关闭的惋惜之情，并提到这些商店在过去提供了独特的购物体验。他们表达了对这些商店逐渐消失的遗憾，并探讨了可能的原因，如租金上涨等。

补充讨论：
• [商店支持与拯救] 一些评论者提到通过捐款（如GoFundMe）支持商店的可能性，并表示会为此贡献。同时，有人提出通过购物支持商店的建议，并提供了可能的在线商店链接。

• [类似商店推荐] 一些评论者分享了其他具有类似精神的商店，如Ax Man Surplus和Weird Stuff Warehouse，为寻找这种独特购物体验的人提供了替代选择。

争议焦点：
• 商店的商品质量和种类变化是争议的主要焦点。一些老顾客对当前商品种类和质量的下降表示不满，而其他顾客则依然对商店的独特性和启发性表示赞赏。

data.title: Read-it-later app Pocket is shutting down – here are the best alternatives
data.author: ashutosh-mishra
data.article_summary:
2025年5月，Mozilla宣布将关闭其于2017年收购的流行稍后阅读应用Pocket，因浏览网络的方式正在改变，Mozilla计划将资源集中在其他项目上。Pocket用户需在2025年10月8日前导出保存的内容。文章推荐了几款替代应用：

1. **Matter**：支持文章收听和播客转录，年费$79.99以解锁更多功能，并提供AI问答助手。Pocket用户可联系ben@getmatter.com获取折扣。

2. **Instapaper**：老牌应用，免费使用，高级功能年费$59.99。Pocket用户可导入账户并获三个月高级会员试用。

3. **Raindrop.io**：书签管理工具，年费$33，提供AI整理和全文搜索等功能。

4. **Plinky**：由前Twitter工程师开发，支持链接保存和分类，Pro版年费$39.99，提供无限文件夹和提醒功能。Pocket用户在2025年5月底前可享Pro级50%折扣。

5. **Paperspan**：简单阅读应用，免费使用，高级功能月费$8.99，但应用更新较少。

用户需在Pocket关闭前迁移数据至其他平台。

44132716.article_content:
In May 2025, Mozilla announced that it was
shutting down the popular read-it-later app Pocket
, which it had acquired
back in 2017 for an undisclosed amount
.
While Pocket helped users save and discover millions of articles, Mozilla said the way people are browsing the web is changing, and it plans to focus its resources on other projects.
Pocket users have until October 8, 2025, to export their saved articles and other items, including lists, archives, favorites, notes, and highlights. This essentially means you will have to find a new home to build a reading list through another save-it-later app.
To help users with this transition, we’ve rounded up a number of apps you might want to consider.
Matter
Matter
is a
Google Ventures-backed company
that makes an eponymous iOS app along with browser extensions for Chrome, Safari, and Firefox. The app lets you listen to
articles and transcribes your favorite podcasts
. Though the app itself is free to use, you can pay $79.99 per year to unlock features like improved transcriptions for podcasts and YouTube videos, tools to adjust reading speed, and additional integrations with other apps like notes apps, Gmail, and Kindle.
Image Credits:
Matter
In March 2025, the company also added
an AI-powered co-reader
to answer questions about different topics users might have while reading an article.
Matter co-founder Ben Springwater says Pocket users can email him at
ben@getmatter.com
for a personal discount link. The company will soon offer the discount within its app and will launch a migration process for Pocket users.
Techcrunch event
Save now through June 4 for TechCrunch Sessions: AI
Save $300 on your ticket to TC Sessions: AI—and get 50% off a second. Hear from leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, Khosla Ventures, and more during a full day of expert insights, hands-on workshops, and high-impact networking. These low-rate deals disappear when the doors open on June 5.
Exhibit at TechCrunch Sessions: AI
Secure your spot at TC Sessions: AI and show 1,200+ decision-makers what you’ve built — without the big spend. Available through May 9 or while tables last.
Berkeley, CA
|
June 5
REGISTER NOW
Instapaper
Instapaper
, which was founded by developer Marco Arment in 2008, is one of the oldest read-it-later apps. It’s available on both iOS and Android, and lets you save unlimited articles and videos without paying any fees. It was
acquired by Pinterest in 2016
.
Image Credits:
Instapaper
However, for $59.99 per year, you can add notes to saved articles, have a permanent archive of articles in your accounts, create a text-to-speech playlist to listen to stories, enable full text search for all saved items, and get the ability to send articles to your Kindle.
The company says
Pocket users can import their account into Instapaper
at instapaper.com/user. Users who import this way will also receive an email offering a three-month free trial to Instapaper Premium.
Raindrop.io
Raindrop
works primarily as an alternative bookmark manager for web browsers. However, its accompanying mobile apps for iOS and Android allow you to read your saved articles or PDFs at any time. The free version gives you unlimited bookmark saving along with integrations like Zapier and IFTTT.
If you decide to pay $33 per year, you will get AI-powered suggestions for organizing your content better, full text-search, reminders for your bookmarks, a duplicate and broken links finder, and a file upload limit of 10GB per month.
Image Credits:
Raindrop.io / raindrop.io
Plinky
Former Twitter engineer Joe Fabisevich
created Plinky to allow users to save and categorize any kind of link
, including articles, videos, recipes, and memes. The app is available across all Apple platforms, along with browser extensions to save links. Once you’re signed up,
Plinky
lets you use folders and tags to categorize your links, and even set reminders to read them at a specific time.
Image Credits:
Plinky
You can save 50 links, create three folders, and use five tags with the free version. To remove these restrictions, you can pay $3.99 per month, $39.99 a year, or a one-time fee of $159.99. Pro users are able to save unlimited links, create an unlimited number of folders, use an unlimited number of tags, and set an unlimited number of reminders.
With Pocket’s shutdown on the horizon,
Fabisevich says
a dedicated Reader Mode will soon be added to Plinky’s app. The app is also offering a 50% discount on the Pro tier through the end of May 2025.
Paperspan
Paperspan
is a very simple app that offers a reading list across devices; allows you to add notes; and has text-to-speech functionality. The app is free, but it offers an $8.99 per month subscription to unlock advanced search, as well as the ability to create playlists, show reading stats, and send your articles to Kindle. Though the app works, PaperSpan hasn’t been updated for some time, which may not be a good signal about its long-term future. The app is available on both iOS and Android.

data.title: What does “Undecidable” mean, anyway
data.author: BerislavLopac
data.article_summary: 这篇文章简要解释了计算机科学中的“不可判定”（Undecidable）概念，主要面向不具备计算机科学背景的读者。作者首先引用了技术定义，即一个属性如果是可判定的，那么存在一个图灵机可以在有限时间内对所有符合该属性的输入返回“真”，对不符合的返回“假”。接着，作者将其转化为程序员更易理解的术语，说明“决策问题”是指那些可以通过函数解决的问题，这些函数的输入是字符串，输出是布尔值。文章还介绍了不同计算模型，如DFA（确定性有限自动机）和图灵机，强调图灵机作为计算模型的上限，能模拟其他模型。最后，文章通过实例说明了如何用图灵机解决复杂问题，并指出某些问题是不可判定的，例如图灵机是否能在有限步数内完成计算。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕可判定性与不可判定性的讨论，涉及计算理论、逻辑以及实际应用中的理解和误解。

不同观点：
• [mreid] 认为理解不可判定性时，关键在于函数 `f : string -> boolean` 的数量远多于能够用程序实现的函数数量。他通过 Cantor 的对角线论证解释了为何存在一些函数无法用程序表示，因为可枚举的程序数量是可数的，而函数的数量是不可数的。
• [ummonk] 对“不可判定性源于其过于强大”的直觉解释持怀疑态度，认为像 bcrypt 破解和国际象棋引擎等问题即使在时间复杂度不理想的情况下也已经可以通过有限算法解决，与不可判定性无关。
• [Animats] 指出确定性有限状态系统在停机问题意义上是可判定的，停机问题的不可判定性只适用于无限内存系统。同时强调了不可判定性与复杂性（如P=NP问题）的区别。
• [taeric] 提出可以将不可判定性类比为 FreeCAD 中的“欠定义”概念，认为程序的某些部分可以被约束以回答特定问题，类似于绘图中部分尺寸被完全定义。
• [nialv7] 提到不可判定问题的存在与实数不可数性之间的联系，但认为文章未深入探讨这一点。
• [godelski] 认为理解哥德尔不完备定理有助于理解不可判定性，指出任何一致的公理系统都无法通过算法列出所有自然数算术的真命题，这与停机问题的不可判定性有内在联系。
• [brap] 提出是否可以像图灵机对计算的形式化模型那样，对“智能”进行形式化模型，探讨智能是否存在分类、极限以及其可数性等问题。
• [skydhash] 分享了理论计算和编程语言理论对其软件工程职业的促进作用，认为这些理论使得对抽象机制的理解和工具的使用变得更加容易。
• [theodorethomas] 质疑为何在知道经典物理学不正确的情况下，仍然依赖90年前提出的、无法物理实现的图灵机模型，并认为其理论限制因此无关紧要。
• [Aziell] 分享了自己对不可判定性的理解过程，认为这是计算本身的极限，而非技术问题。
• [cubefox] 指出“不可判定”在计算机科学和形式逻辑中有不同含义，前者与停机问题相关，后者与命题的独立性相关，并探讨了两者可能的联系。
• [Tainnor] 提到对不可判定性的两个常见误解：1. 将特定实例的可判定性与整个问题的可判定性混淆；2. 认为有限内存的实际计算机可以绕过不可判定性问题，而不考虑实际可操作性。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是“过于强大”的直觉解释是否有效，[ummonk] 认为像 bcrypt 破解和国际象棋等问题已经有有限算法解决方案，与不可判定性无关。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是 [theodorethomas] 对经典物理学与图灵机模型适用性的质疑，认为在量子力学时代，图灵机模型的理论限制可能 irrelevant。
• [cubefox] 提出的“不可判定”在不同领域中的不同含义，以及它们之间可能的联系，为理解不可判定性提供了更广泛的视角。

总结：评论中涉及的讨论涵盖了从理论计算到实际应用的多个方面，包括对不可判定性的直观理解、不同领域中的含义与联系、以及与复杂性问题的区别等。这些观点展示了不可判定性在计算理论中的核心地位以及其广泛影响。

44119890.article_content:
May 28, 2025
What does "Undecidable" mean, anyway
An explainer for people who don't know computer science and are mildly curious
Systems Distributed
I'll be speaking at
Systems Distributed
next month! The talk is brand new and will aim to showcase some of the formal methods mental models that would be useful in mainstream software development. It has added some extra stress on my schedule, though, so expect the next two monthly releases of
Logic for Programmers
to be mostly minor changes.
What does "Undecidable" mean, anyway
Last week I read
Against Curry-Howard Mysticism
, which is a solid article I recommend reading. But this newsletter is actually about
one comment
:
I like to see posts like this because I often feel like I can’t tell the difference between BS and a point I’m missing. Can we get one for questions like “Isn’t XYZ (Undecidable|NP-Complete|PSPACE-Complete)?”
I've already written one of these for
NP-complete
, so let's do one for "undecidable". Step one is to pull a technical definition from the book
Automata and Computability
:
A property P of strings is said to be decidable if ... there is a total Turing machine that accepts input strings that have property P and rejects those that do not. (pg 220)
Step two is to translate the technical computer science definition into more conventional programmer terms. Warning, because this is a newsletter and not a blog post, I might be a little sloppy with terms.
Machines and Decision Problems
In automata theory, all inputs to a "program" are strings of characters, and all outputs are "true" or "false". A program "accepts" a string if it outputs "true", and "rejects" if it outputs "false". You can think of this as automata studying all pure functions of type
f :: string -> boolean
. Problems solvable by finding such an
f
are called "decision problems".
This covers more than you'd think, because we can bootstrap more powerful functions from these. First, as anyone who's programmed in bash knows, strings can represent any other data. Second, we can fake non-boolean outputs by instead checking if a certain computation gives a certain result. For example, I can reframe the function
add(x, y) = x + y
as a decision problem like this:
IS_SUM(str) {
x, y, z = split(str, "#")
return x + y == z
}
Then because
IS_SUM("2#3#5")
returns true, we know
2 + 3 == 5
, while
IS_SUM("2#3#6")
is false. Since we can bootstrap parameters out of strings, I'll just say it's
IS_SUM(x, y, z)
going forward.
A big part of automata theory is studying different models of computation with different strengths. One of the weakest is called
"DFA"
. I won't go into any details about what DFA actually can do, but the important thing is that it
can't
solve
IS_SUM
. That is, if you give me a DFA that takes inputs of form
x#y#z
, I can always find an input where the DFA returns true when
x + y != z
,
or
an input which returns false when
x + y == z
.
It's really important to keep this model of "solve" in mind: a program solves a problem if it correctly returns true on all true inputs and correctly returns false on all false inputs.
(total) Turing Machines
A Turing Machine (TM) is a particular type of computation model. It's important for two reasons:
By the
Church-Turing thesis
, a Turing Machine is the "upper bound" of how powerful (physically realizable) computational models can get. This means that if an actual real-world programming language can solve a particular decision problem, so can a TM. Conversely, if the TM
can't
solve it, neither can the programming language.
1
It's possible to write a Turing machine that takes
a textual representation of another Turing machine
as input, and then simulates that Turing machine as part of its computations.
Property (1) means that we can move between different computational models of equal strength, proving things about one to learn things about another. That's why I'm able to write
IS_SUM
in a pseudocode instead of writing it in terms of the TM computational model (and why I was able to use
split
for convenience).
Property (2) does several interesting things. First of all, it makes it possible to compose Turing machines. Here's how I can roughly ask if a given number is the sum of two primes, with "just" addition and boolean functions:
IS_SUM_TWO_PRIMES(z):
x := 1
y := 1
loop {
if x > z {return false}
if IS_PRIME(x) {
if IS_PRIME(y) {
if IS_SUM(x, y, z) {
return true;
}
}
}
y := y + 1
if y > x {
x := x + 1
y := 0
}
}
Notice that without the
if x > z {return false}
, the program would loop forever on
z=2
. A TM that always halts for all inputs is called
total
.
Property (2) also makes "Turing machines" a possible input to functions, meaning that we can now make decision problems about the behavior of Turing machines. For example, "does the TM
M
either accept or reject
x
within ten steps?"
2
IS_DONE_IN_TEN_STEPS(M, x) {
for (i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
`simulate M(x) for one step`
if(`M accepted or rejected`) {
return true
}
}
return false
}

44119890.article_summary: 这篇文章简要解释了计算机科学中的“不可判定”（Undecidable）概念，主要面向不具备计算机科学背景的读者。作者首先引用了技术定义，即一个属性如果是可判定的，那么存在一个图灵机可以在有限时间内对所有符合该属性的输入返回“真”，对不符合的返回“假”。接着，作者将其转化为程序员更易理解的术语，说明“决策问题”是指那些可以通过函数解决的问题，这些函数的输入是字符串，输出是布尔值。文章还介绍了不同计算模型，如DFA（确定性有限自动机）和图灵机，强调图灵机作为计算模型的上限，能模拟其他模型。最后，文章通过实例说明了如何用图灵机解决复杂问题，并指出某些问题是不可判定的，例如图灵机是否能在有限步数内完成计算。
44119890.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕可判定性与不可判定性的讨论，涉及计算理论、逻辑以及实际应用中的理解和误解。

不同观点：
• [mreid] 认为理解不可判定性时，关键在于函数 `f : string -> boolean` 的数量远多于能够用程序实现的函数数量。他通过 Cantor 的对角线论证解释了为何存在一些函数无法用程序表示，因为可枚举的程序数量是可数的，而函数的数量是不可数的。
• [ummonk] 对“不可判定性源于其过于强大”的直觉解释持怀疑态度，认为像 bcrypt 破解和国际象棋引擎等问题即使在时间复杂度不理想的情况下也已经可以通过有限算法解决，与不可判定性无关。
• [Animats] 指出确定性有限状态系统在停机问题意义上是可判定的，停机问题的不可判定性只适用于无限内存系统。同时强调了不可判定性与复杂性（如P=NP问题）的区别。
• [taeric] 提出可以将不可判定性类比为 FreeCAD 中的“欠定义”概念，认为程序的某些部分可以被约束以回答特定问题，类似于绘图中部分尺寸被完全定义。
• [nialv7] 提到不可判定问题的存在与实数不可数性之间的联系，但认为文章未深入探讨这一点。
• [godelski] 认为理解哥德尔不完备定理有助于理解不可判定性，指出任何一致的公理系统都无法通过算法列出所有自然数算术的真命题，这与停机问题的不可判定性有内在联系。
• [brap] 提出是否可以像图灵机对计算的形式化模型那样，对“智能”进行形式化模型，探讨智能是否存在分类、极限以及其可数性等问题。
• [skydhash] 分享了理论计算和编程语言理论对其软件工程职业的促进作用，认为这些理论使得对抽象机制的理解和工具的使用变得更加容易。
• [theodorethomas] 质疑为何在知道经典物理学不正确的情况下，仍然依赖90年前提出的、无法物理实现的图灵机模型，并认为其理论限制因此无关紧要。
• [Aziell] 分享了自己对不可判定性的理解过程，认为这是计算本身的极限，而非技术问题。
• [cubefox] 指出“不可判定”在计算机科学和形式逻辑中有不同含义，前者与停机问题相关，后者与命题的独立性相关，并探讨了两者可能的联系。
• [Tainnor] 提到对不可判定性的两个常见误解：1. 将特定实例的可判定性与整个问题的可判定性混淆；2. 认为有限内存的实际计算机可以绕过不可判定性问题，而不考虑实际可操作性。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是“过于强大”的直觉解释是否有效，[ummonk] 认为像 bcrypt 破解和国际象棋等问题已经有有限算法解决方案，与不可判定性无关。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是 [theodorethomas] 对经典物理学与图灵机模型适用性的质疑，认为在量子力学时代，图灵机模型的理论限制可能 irrelevant。
• [cubefox] 提出的“不可判定”在不同领域中的不同含义，以及它们之间可能的联系，为理解不可判定性提供了更广泛的视角。

总结：评论中涉及的讨论涵盖了从理论计算到实际应用的多个方面，包括对不可判定性的直观理解、不同领域中的含义与联系、以及与复杂性问题的区别等。这些观点展示了不可判定性在计算理论中的核心地位以及其广泛影响。

data.author: AlexeyBrin
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了为Raspberry Pi Pico和Pico 2设计的PicoMite固件，它包含一个兼容微软BASIC的解释器，并支持丰富的硬件功能，如触控LCD面板、SD卡、WiFi/互联网等。PicoMite固件基于MMBasic，支持浮点数、整数、字符串变量、数组和长变量名，内置程序编辑器。它可以通过I2C或SPI协议获取传感器数据，支持在LCD显示信息、保存数据到SD卡、测量电压等。固件有不同版本，分别支持嵌入式控制器、自带计算机（带VGA/HDMI输出和键盘）、以及WiFi/互联网连接控制器等应用。程序开发通过串行USB接口使用终端仿真器完成，开发简便，错误提示清晰，支持快速编辑和运行。MMBasic还支持SD卡文件操作（FAT16/FAT32，最大32GB），兼容Windows文件系统。

主要讨论点：对Adafruit Fruit Jam（基于RP2350芯片的设备）的性能、潜力和适用性的评价。

不同观点：
• [raphlinus的观点] 对Adafruit Fruit Jam的发布感到兴奋，认为它是一台完整的小型计算机，具备多个USB接口、HDMI输出、SD卡槽、高质量音频输出、RGB LED和额外的PSRAM等功能。raphlinus特别指出，与RP2040相比，RP2350在实现HDMI输出方面更加简单直接，且能够在不超频的情况下支持640x480的标准分辨率。在超频情况下，可以实现1280x720 60Hz的输出。不过，由于RAM有限，帧缓冲（framebuffers）效果不佳，因此他正在探索实时生成视频的方案。总体上，raphlinus高度评价RP2350，认为它是低级编程爱好者的绝佳选择。

• [morninglight的观点] 没有直接对设备本身发表评论，而是分享了一个视频链接，暗示该视频可能是一个很好的入门起点。这个观点似乎更注重实际操作和学习资源的分享，而非设备的技术细节或潜力分析。

补充讨论：
• raphlinus提到了RP2350的视频输出功能不需要超频即可实现标准分辨率，这在技术实现上比之前的RP2040更为简单，显示出技术进步。
• raphlinus还提到在超频情况下可以实现更高的分辨率（1280x720），但需要注意减少空白区域，并且因为RAM限制，帧缓冲效果有限。
• morninglight提供的视频链接可能对初学者有帮助，展示了如何开始使用类似的设备。

争议焦点：
• 暂无明显争议，但raphlinus对RP2350的技术细节和潜力有深入分析，而morninglight则提供了实用资源，侧重点不同。

BASIC  for the Raspberry Pi Pico & Pico 2
The PicoMite firmware for the Raspberry Pi Pico and Pico 2 is a complete operating system with a Microsoft BASIC compatible interpreter and extensive hardware support including touch sensitive LCD panels, SD Cards, WiFi/Internet and much more.
MMBasic is a full featured implementation of the BASIC language with floating point, integer and string variables, arrays, long variable names, a built in program editor and many other features.
Using MMBasic you can use communications protocols such as I
2
C or SPI to get data from a variety of sensors.  You can save data to an SD card, display information on  colour LCD displays, measure voltages, detect digital inputs and drive output pins to turn on lights, relays, etc.  All from inside this low cost microcontroller.
The PicoMite firmware is totally free to download and use.
Firmware Versions
The PicoMite firmware comes in twelve versions that are intended to be used in three general applications depending on the periphal support included in each version (ie, touch sensitive LCD panels, VGA/HDMI output, WiFi/Internet capabibility, etc).  The user manual (
at the bottom of this page
) goes into this in more detail but, in summary, the three typical applications for the PicoMite firmware are:
Embedded Controller
.  This is where the Raspberry Pi Pico or Pico 2 is used as the brains inside some device.  For example, a burglar alarm, a heating controller, weather station, etc.
This application is described in detail below
.
Self Contained Computer
.  These have a VGA or HDMI video output and a PS2 or USB keyboard and boot up to display the output of the BASIC interpreter on the video monitor.   They make for a simple and fun computer similar to the home computers that were popular in the 70s and 80s, for example the Apple II, Tandy TRS-80, Commodore 64 and others. This is described in more detail here:
https://geoffg.net/picomitevga.html
WiFi/Internet Connected Controller
.  These supports the wireless interface on the Raspberry Pi Pico W (and 2 W) and using this you can create an embedded controller which has a miniature web server running on the Pico and can access the Internet to get the time, send emails, etc. This is described in more detail here:
https://geoffg.net/webmite.html
The following describes the use of the PicoMite firmware as an embedded controller.
Program Development
When the Raspberry Pi Pico or Pico 2 is used as an embedded controller the program development is done on the  device using a terminal emulator on a PC (
Windows, Linux or MacOS
) connected  via a serial over USB interface to the Pico's USB connector.  No special software or hardware is required other than the terminal emulator which is free.  Over this USB interface the programmer can configure features, test BASIC commands, edit the program and run the program.
When the program is complete it can be set to automatically run on power up and the PC connection removed.  The Pico will then independently run its program forever.  The terminal emulator and PC can be reconnected at any time to modify or update the running program.
The emphasis with MMBasic is on ease of use and development.  The development cycle is very fast with the ability to instantly switch from edit to run.  Errors are listed in plain English and when an error does occur a single keystroke will invoke the built in editor with the cursor positioned on the line that caused the error.
Hardware Support
MMBasic supports all the hardware features of the Raspberry Pi Pico (serial, I
2
C, SPI, CPU clock, ADC, etc) and adds  support for:
SD Cards
with FAT16 or FAT32 file systems up to 32GB.  Files can be created and read/written using both sequential or random access.  Directories can be created/deleted and navigated.  Long file and directory names are supported and the files written are fully compatible with Windows,

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：CSS Minecraft项目的技术实现、影响及其引发的相关问题

不同观点：
• **对项目的赞赏**：
  - **globie**：认为这是其见过的最令人印象深刻的CSS项目，比"A Single Div"更酷，后者曾是其见过的最酷CSS演示。
  - **simonw**：认为项目非常聪明且优雅，并为其写了博客解析。
  - **bradly**：对项目印象深刻，并提到其回归HTML和CSS开发的乐趣，但希望看到纯CSS的随机数生成。
  - **nightpool**：认为项目不仅展示了HTML的强大，也体现了Minecraft概念的简单和吸引力。

• **对技术细节的讨论**：
  - **skulk**：指出项目通过radio buttons管理状态，HTML中包含所有可能放置的方块。
  - **Kholin**：强调了通过改变animation-play-state值和使用:active伪类实现旋转和移动控制的方式非常出色。
  - **low_tech_punk**：认为Pug模板引擎在项目中发挥了重要作用，通过4层嵌套循环强制生成UI。

• **对项目爆红的反应**：
  - **benjaminaster**（项目作者）：提到项目三年前制作，尝试CSS的极限，使用了新的:has()选择器。项目直到现在才获得关注，导致其网站因流量过大而崩溃，已更换到Cloudflare并提供了GitHub Pages链接。
  - **avestura**：提到网站因流量过大而显示“必须通过Firebase控制台升级才能继续服务”，并提供了Wayback Machine链接。
  - **frozenlettuce**：调侃这是最好的反Firebase帖子。

• **对项目未获早期关注的看法**：
  - **noman-land**：认为项目在2.5年前完全未被注意到，并提供了Hacker News的讨论链接。

补充讨论：
• **项目链接和资源**：
  - **benjaminaster**：提供了GitHub源码链接和视频演示。
  - **simonw**：提供了博客解析链接，并提到CSS文件只有480行，但HTML文件有46,022行。
  - **ElCapitanMarkla**：提到项目让他想起了Keith Clark十年前的项目，提供了相关链接。

争议焦点：
• 项目因爆红导致原网站崩溃，作者更换了托管服务。

data.article_summary: 文章探讨了如果人类或人工智能拥有更多神经元，可能会出现哪些新能力。人类大脑有约1000亿个神经元，这使我们能够使用复杂的语言。相比之下，猫的大脑只有约1亿个神经元，无法使用语言。文章思考了拥有100万亿个神经元的大脑可能带来的新能力，并指出大脑通过处理大量感官数据来做出决策，利用“计算可约性”的简化特征来应对世界的复杂性。文章还讨论了语言和概念的压缩功能，并提出更大的大脑可能能够处理更多概念和词汇。最终，文章设想了科学和技术的进步可能通过识别更多计算可约性特征来增强大脑能力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：大脑的处理能力、智力与认知的局限性、进化与环境对认知的影响、以及未来智力的发展方向。

不同观点：
• **necovek**：认为大脑处理信息的方式是并行的，而不是单线程的。通过学习新技能（如运动或乐器），人们可以同时处理多种信息流。同时，提出人类可能有能力进行并行的有意识思考，但通常被训练成只输出单一结果。
  
• **benrutter**：虽然承认大脑的计算能力与智力相关，但强调智力不仅仅取决于处理能力，还包括概念表示和关系的能力。智力上的突破往往来自于对自身想法的判断和对其局限性的理解，而非纯粹的计算能力。

• **keiferski**：提出文章忽视了环境和具身认知（embodied cognition）的重要性。认为认知不仅仅是脑部计算过程，还包括身体与环境的互动，过度关注大脑而忽略环境是片面的。

• **efitz**：以幽默的方式质疑如果拥有更多神经元，是否会增加对自我关注的程度，而不是实际的智力提升。

• **voxelghost**：通过比较不同物种的神经元数量，提出更多神经元不一定意味着更高的智力或更大的意义，可能只是不同的认知方式。

• **x86cherry**：认为智力可能不是由大脑大小决定的，而是由新经验和认知能力（如贝叶斯推理）决定的。重复性工作和有限的经验可能限制了我们智力的发展。

• **b00ty4breakfast**：质疑“更聪明就更好”的假设，提出智力可能并不是解决所有问题的关键，甚至可能是某些问题的根源。建议在追求更大智力的同时，先学会如何负责任地使用已有的智力。

• **zabzonk**：从科幻作品引申，提出大脑增大会带来散热等实际问题，并质疑这种增强是否会让人类失去一些人性。

• **Permik**：扩展“心智”的定义，提出像公司这样的抽象生命体也可以被视为高级智能生命形式，并认为我们对“心智”和“智力”的理解过于狭隘。

• **nssnsjsjsjs**：认为人类通过人口增长和集体智慧扩展了“大脑”容量，而不是通过个体大脑的增大。

• **Aziell**：提出大脑的局限性使得我们难以专注和深入思考，并不是因为不够努力，而是由于大脑结构的限制，使得我们难以理解某些复杂的概念。

• **ednite**：讨论了大脑体积与智力的关系，以及人工智能可能带来的快速智力进化，提出未来可能出现我们无法理解的新思维和语言。

• **rel_ic**：幽默地认为人类可能只是存在于一个更大的大脑中的神经元，引用了《Gödel, Escher, Bach》一书中的观点。

• **nitwit005**：提出大脑增大可能会带来负面影响，如更高的沟通成本和散热问题，认为进化可能已经将我们的大脑推到了实际收益的极限。

• **Elaris**：质疑更大的大脑是否会带来更多的幸福和满足，担心更大的智力可能导致孤独和与他人失去联系，而不是更多的快乐。

补充讨论：
- 争议的焦点在于大脑的处理能力是否可以通过增大或增强来提升智力，以及这种提升是否会带来更多的好处或问题。
- 另一个值得注意的点是对“心智”和“智力”定义的扩展，提出了抽象生命体和集体智慧的概念。
- 环境和具身认知在认知过程中的重要性也被多次提到，强调了大脑与环境的互动。

What If We Had Bigger Brains? Imagining Minds beyond Ours
May 21, 2025
Cats Don’t Talk
We humans have perhaps 100 billion neurons in our brains. But what if we had many more? Or what if the AIs we built effectively had many more? What kinds of things might then become possible? At 100 billion neurons, we know, for example, that compositional language of the kind we humans use is possible. At the 100 million or so neurons of a cat, it doesn’t seem to be. But what would become possible with 100 trillion neurons? And is it even something we could imagine understanding?
My purpose here is to start exploring such questions, informed by what we’ve seen in recent years in neural nets and LLMs, as well as by what we now know about the
fundamental nature of computation
, and about neuroscience and the operation of actual brains (like the one that’s writing this, imaged here):
One suggestive point is that as artificial neural nets have gotten bigger, they seem to have successively passed a sequence of thresholds in capability:
So what’s next? No doubt there’ll be things like humanoid robotic control that have close analogs in what we humans already do. But what if we go far beyond the ~10
14
connections that our human brains have? What qualitatively new kinds of capabilities might there then be?
If this was about “computation in general” then there wouldn’t really be much to talk about. The
Principle of Computational Equivalence
implies that beyond some low threshold computational systems can generically produce behavior that corresponds to computation that’s as sophisticated as it can ever be. And indeed that’s the kind of thing we see both in lots of abstract settings, and in the natural world.
But the point here is that we’re not dealing with “computation in general”. We’re dealing with the kinds of computations that brains fundamentally do. And the essence of these seems to have to do with taking in large amounts of sensory data and then coming up with what amount to decisions about what to do next.
It’s not obvious that there’d be any reasonable way to do this. The world at large is full of
computational irreducibility
—where the only general way to work out what will happen in a system is just to run the underlying rules for that system step by step and see what comes out:
And, yes, there are plenty of questions and issues for which there’s essentially no choice but to
do this irreducible computation
—just as there are plenty of cases where
LLMs need
to
call on
our
Wolfram Language
computation system to get computations done. But brains, for the things most important to them, somehow seem to routinely manage to “jump ahead” without in effect simulating every detail. And what makes this possible is the fundamental fact that within any system that shows overall computational irreducibility there must inevitably be an infinite number of “pockets of computational reducibility”, in effect associated with “simplifying features” of the behavior of the system.
It’s these “pockets of reducibility” that brains exploit to be able to successfully “navigate” the world for their purposes in spite of its “background” of computational irreducibility. And in these terms things like the progress of science (and technology) can basically be thought of as the identification of progressively more pockets of computational reducibility. And we can then imagine that the capabilities of bigger brains could revolve around being able to “hold in mind” more of these pockets of computational reducibility.
We can think of brains as fundamentally serving to
“compress” the complexity of the world
, and extract from it just certain features—associated with pockets of reducibility—that we care about. And for us a key manifestation of this is the idea of concepts, and of language that uses them. At the level of raw sensory input we might see many detailed images of some category of thing—but language lets us describe them all just in terms of one particular symbolic concept (say “rock”).
In a rough first approximation, we can imagine that there’s a direct correspondence between concepts and words in our language. And it’s then notable that human languages all tend to have perhaps 30,000 common words (or word-like constructs). So is that scale the result of the size of our brains? And could bigger brains perhaps deal with many more words, say millions or more?
“What could all those words be about?” we might ask. After all, our everyday experience makes it seem like our current 30,000 words are quite sufficient to describe the world as it is. But in some sense this is circular: we’ve invented the words we have because they’re wh

data.title: The David Lynch Collection
data.author: Duanemclemore
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：名人遗物拍卖及其引发的各种反应

不同观点：
• [kubb] 认为在名人去世后，将其物品高价出售以牟利的行为是不安的，这种行为结合了冷漠、消费主义、贪婪以及对名人的盲目崇拜。他质疑这种现象，并认为这可能只是他的个人感受。
• [Duanemclemore] 则从一个粉丝的角度出发，认为拍卖提供了一个难得的窥探名人生活和创作过程的机会，并且对这种体验表示欣赏，即使是一些普通的物品也让他觉得有趣。他还提到某些物品如咖啡机被高价拍卖的现象，但并没有对此表示强烈反对。
• [frereubu] 对拍卖价格表示不解，特别是当一些非常普通的物品也被高价拍走时，他觉得这与他的价值观不同，并提到类似的情况在其他名人拍卖中也曾发生。
• [Klaster_1] 对一个典型美国人或富有人士拥有大量物品的现象表示惊讶，质疑这是否是美国社会的常态。
• [me4502] 希望一些有注释的剧本等物品能够进入电影或媒体博物馆，认为这些物品具有文化和历史价值。
• [reconnecting] 关注的是David Lynch的个人选择和品味，比如他的咖啡机、相机和音乐设备，但对某些设备的选择表示不解，认为它们与Lynch的其他设备风格不符。

补充讨论：
• [jiriro] 和 [joeevans1000] 以幽默的方式参与讨论，分别提出拥有这些物品是否能使人成为David Lynch，以及借机推销自己的物品，增加了一些轻松的氛围。
• [nicholasbraker] 表达了对某些特定拍卖品的兴趣，但并未深入讨论。
• [sidcool] 和 [padjo] 都认为拍卖品定价过高，显示出对价格的不满。
• [cempaka] 提到一些特定书籍引发了特定社交媒体群体的关注，增加了讨论的文化和政治维度。
• [HenryBemis] 则借机讨论了拍卖中发现的其他作者和书籍，扩展了讨论的范围。

争议焦点：
• 拍卖名人遗物是否道德以及高价拍普通物品的现象是否合理。一些人认为这是对名人的不尊重和牟利行为，而另一些人则认为这是一种欣赏和了解名人生活的机会。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• David Lynch的个人品味和生活方式引起了一些参与者对其设备选择的讨论。
• 某些拍卖品如书籍引发的文化和政治讨论，增加了讨论的深度和广度。

总结：讨论围绕名人遗物拍卖展开，涉及道德、价格合理性、文化价值以及个人品味等多个方面，展示了不同参与者对这一现象的多元看法。

data.title: Buttplug MCP
data.author: surrTurr
data.article_summary:
**buttplug-mcp** 是一个为 Buttplug.io 生态系统开发的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，允许像 Claude Desktop 这样的工具支持的大语言模型程序查询和控制生殖器接口设备。用户可以发出指令如查询连接设备、设置震动强度、检查电池电量等。然而，当前版本的体验不稳定，连接处理存在问题，go-buttplug 库的连接不稳定导致设备无法震动。该项目始于2025年4月1日（愚人节），作为一个教育性项目，尚未实现端到端测试。

支持的资源和工具包括设备列表、RSSI信号水平、电池电量以及设备震动控制。二进制文件通过 GitHub Actions 发布，也可以通过 Homebrew 安装。使用时需要下载 Intiface Central 管理设备，并配置主机程序以连接 buttplug-mcp 服务器。

不同观点：
• [技术开放性与专有性对比]  
  - Perz1val提出疑问，为何性玩具的控制API是开放的，而非预期的专有和封闭。他认为这可能是因为大型企业尚未进入该市场，因此没有导致专有锁定。
  
• [技术实现与创新]  
  - bennett_dev提出将Buttplug与ChatGPT结合，用于实现有趣的应用场景，比如制作一个有趣的闹钟。
  - doingtheiroming则幽默地表达期望该项目像过去安全工具命名一样，具备某种“恶意”特性（指命名上的创新性）。

buttplug-mcp - Buttplug.io MCP Server
buttplug-mcp
is a
Model Context Protocol (MCP)
server for the
Buttplug.io ecosystem
.  It allows Tool-supporting LLM programs like
Claude Desktop
query and control your Genital Interface Devices.
|insert AI-generated slop image of robots doing nasty things|
LLM|=> - - (__(__)
Once set up, you can prompt your LLM:
"What are my connected buttplug devices?"
"Set the second motor on my LELO F1S to 50% strength"
"How much battery is left on my Lovense Max 2?"
"Does my WeWibe have weak signal?"
NOTE: The above is aspirational and really the
current experience
is unstable and frustating.
It supports the following Resources and Tools:
Resource
Description
/devices
List of connected Buttplug devices in JSON.
/device/{id}
Device information by device ID where
id
is a number from
/devices
/device/{id}/rssi
RSSI signal level by device ID where
id
is a number from
/devices
/device/{id}/battery
Battery level by device ID where
id
is a number from
/devices
Tool
Params
Description
device_vibrate
id
,
motor
,
strength
Vibrates device by
id
, selecting
strength
and optional
motor
JSON Schema for Resources.  Click to expand
schema_resources.json
{
"jsonrpc": "2.0",
"id": 1,
"result": {
"resources": [
{
"uri": "devices",
"name": "Device List",
"description": "List of connected Buttplug devices in JSON",
"mimeType": "application/json"
}
]
}
}
JSON Schema for Tools.  Click to expand
schema_tools.json
{
"jsonrpc": "2.0",
"id": 1,
"result": {
"tools": [
{
"description": "Vibrates device by `id`, selecting `strength` and optional `motor`",
"inputSchema": {
"type": "object",
"properties": {
"id": {
"description": "Device ID to query, sourced from `/devices`",
"pattern": "^[0-9]*$",
"type": "number"
},
"motor": {
"description": "Motor number to vibrate, defaults to 0",
"pattern": "^[0-9]*$",
"type": "number"
},
"strength": {
"description": "Strength from 0.0 to 1.0, with 0.0 being off and 1.0 being full",
"pattern": "^(0(\\.\\d+)?|1(\\.0+)?)$",
"type": "number"
}
},
"required": [
"id",
"strength"
]
},
"name": "device_vibrate"
}
]
}
}
Current State
I started working on this on 2025-04-01, April Fool's Day, after having created another experimental MCP service,
dbn-go
for financial market data
, the day prior.  So it is fresh meat and was intended as a quick, fun educational project.
While it does work, I found the underlying
go-buttplug
library
to be unstable in connection handling.   I could ask Claude for my devices, but my specific device wouldn't vibrate even just with just Intiface Central -- it was like in read-only mode!    I also wish I had a virtual buttplug.io device for testing, rather than relying on a physical device.
So, it has not truly been tested "end-to-end" 😉
I will dig more into the
go-buttplug
library and see why connections are unstable.  I also need to understand the MCP protocol current state of MCP hosts -- it seems they focus on Tools rather than Resources and Resoure Templates.
Installing the binary
Binaries for multiple platforms are
released on GitHub
through
GitHub Actions
.
You can also install for various platforms with
Homebrew
from
conacademy/homebrew-tap
:
brew tap conacademy/homebrew-tap
brew install conacademy/tap/buttplug-mcp
Usage
Download the
Intiface Central
hub application to manage your devices.  Start it and note the server port (default seems to be
12345
).
To use this the
buttplug-mcp
MCP server, you must configure your host program to use it.  We will illustrate with
Claude Desktop
.  We must find the
buttplug-mcp
program on our system; the example below shows where
buttplug-mcp
is installed with MacOS Homebrew (perhaps build your own and point at that).
The following
configuration JSON
sets this up:
{
"mcpServers"
: {
"buttplug"
: {
"command"
:
"
/opt/homebrew/bin/buttplug-mcp
"
,
"args"
: [
"
--ws-port
"
,
"
12345
"
]
}
}
}
Using Claude Desktop, you can follow
their configuration tutorial
but substitute the configuration above.  With that in place, you can ask Claude question and it will use the
buttplug-mcp
server.  Here's example conver

**buttplug-mcp** 是一个为 Buttplug.io 生态系统开发的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务器，允许像 Claude Desktop 这样的工具支持的大语言模型程序查询和控制生殖器接口设备。用户可以发出指令如查询连接设备、设置震动强度、检查电池电量等。然而，当前版本的体验不稳定，连接处理存在问题，go-buttplug 库的连接不稳定导致设备无法震动。该项目始于2025年4月1日（愚人节），作为一个教育性项目，尚未实现端到端测试。

主要讨论点：关于使用Tesla和Mapillary等工具创建自动化的视频和GPX数据管道的可行性和实用性，以及对数据归属和隐私问题的讨论。

不同观点：
• [puddingvlaai] 认为可以通过结合teslausb和teslamate创建一个自动化的数据检索管道，并增加"排除位置"功能，使其成为一个完整的解决方案。
• [jfoster] 提到文章已有5年历史，质疑该项目是否仍在发展，并询问Mapillary的数据是否能在OSM界面中直接查看。
• [Ruthalas] 指出，如果不希望贡献给Mapillary，可以选择像Panoramax这样的替代方案，它是完全开源的，且不属于Meta公司。
• [mft_] 分享了自己的经历，尝试使用Tesla进行类似的项目，但由于teslausb的不稳定性而未能成功实施。
• [furkansahin] 认为这个想法有创意，但不切实际，特别是对于普通Tesla车主来说，实施起来过于复杂，且文章未详细讨论如何实际应用。
• [jbverschoor] 简单表示，近实时的街景功能会很酷。
• [mdhb] 提出质疑，认为这种做法相当于为Meta无偿收集监控数据，因为Meta最终控制了数据源。

补充讨论：
• 关于Mapillary和Panoramax的讨论，涉及到数据归属权和隐私问题，特别是由大公司（如Meta）控制的数据源引发的担忧。
• 有人对项目的实际可操作性和可扩展性提出质疑，认为对于普通用户来说，实施步骤过于繁琐复杂。
• 对近实时街景功能的潜在价值进行了简单讨论，但未深入探讨技术细节。

争议焦点：
• 使用Tesla进行数据收集的实际可行性和复杂度，特别是对于普通用户的适用性。
• 数据归属和隐私问题，尤其是涉及到大公司控制数据源的情况下，用户是否应参与这种无偿的数据贡献。

data.title: RFK Jr's 'Maha' report found to contain citations to nonexistent studies
data.author: KnuthIsGod
data.article_summary: 罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 Jr. 为特朗普政府编写的“让美国再次健康”报告被发现包含不存在的研究引用。美国媒体Notus的调查显示，该报告引用了七项似乎完全虚构的研究，还有一些研究被误述。例如，两项关于多动症药物广告的研究在所称的期刊中并不存在，一名被列为作者的研究员否认撰写过相关论文。此外，报告还错误地描述了其他研究，如一项关于谈话疗法效果的研究。肯尼迪本周还批评顶级医学期刊腐败，并计划创建政府运营的期刊。该报告引发了对其科学可信度的担忧，后续报告预计在八月发布。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对现状变化的看法、企业影响力、AI生成内容的可靠性以及社会 truth 的侵蚀。

不同观点：
• **roenxi** 认为当前的变化并未显著偏离现状，且对政府在疫情期间实施的缺乏证据的极端政策表示不满，指出美国企业从政府政策中获益。虽然报告在企业影响力方面着墨较多，但 sourcing 不够 robust，不过还有更重要的议题值得讨论。

• **justacrow** 以讽刺的方式建议 OpenAI 投资一个专门生成引用的服务 (Citations-as-a-Service)，以解决 AI 生成内容缺乏可靠来源的问题。

• **andy_ppp** 表达了对社会规范被侵蚀的担忧，认为社会已经从寻找改变观点的想法转向寻找证实自己怀疑的事实，并担心一个没有 truth 的社会注定会失败。

• **max_** 直言大型语言模型 (LLMs) 是净负面影响，提到在 Value Investors Club 中因为太多人提交 AI 生成的低质量分析，股票分析提交已被暂停。

• **sandworm101** 以幽默方式询问关于吃未煮熟熊肉导致的寄生虫影响的问题，属于偏离主要讨论的旁注。

• **nssnsjsjsjs** 指出 Maha 也是一个阿拉伯名字，与主要讨论主题无关。

• **comrade1234** 以讽刺语气询问“dupe”在重复三或四次情况下的表达方式，也是对讨论主题的旁注。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是政府政策与企业利益之间的关系，以及这些政策是否基于证据。**roenxi** 对缺乏证据的极端政策表示不满，并指出企业从这些政策中获益。

• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是对 AI 生成内容可靠性的质疑。**justacrow** 提出的讽刺建议和 **max_** 提到的实际案例（Value Investors Club 中的 AI 生成内容问题）都指向了这一问题。

• **andy_ppp** 的评论引发了对社会 truth 侵蚀的深层次担忧，强调了寻找事实和证实怀疑之间的冲突，以及这种冲突对社会的潜在影响。

总体来看，评论中涉及了对政策、企业影响力、AI 技术影响以及社会 truth 侵蚀的多角度讨论，展现了对当前社会和技术变化的复杂看法。

Robert F Kennedy Jr testifies before a Senate hearing on 20 May.
Photograph: Manuel Balce Ceneta/AP
View image in fullscreen
Robert F Kennedy Jr testifies before a Senate hearing on 20 May.
Photograph: Manuel Balce Ceneta/AP
Trump administration
RFK Jr’s ‘Maha’ report found to contain citations to nonexistent studies
Failures uncovered as US health secretary touted ‘gold-standard’ science in health report ordered by Trump team
US politics live – latest updates
Joseph Gedeon
in Washington
Thu 29 May 2025 12.56 EDT
Last modified on Thu 29 May 2025 13.46 EDT
Share
Robert F Kennedy Jr
’s flagship
health commission report
contains citations to studies that do not exist, according to an
investigation
by the US publication Notus.
The report exposes glaring scientific failures from a health secretary who earlier this week threatened to ban government scientists from publishing in leading medical journals.
The 73-page “Make America healthy again” report – which was commissioned by the
Trump administration
to examine the causes of chronic illness, and which Kennedy promoted it as “gold-standard” science backed by more than 500 citations – includes references to seven studies that appear to be entirely invented, and others that the researchers say have been mischaracterized.
Key takeaways: RFK Jr’s ‘Maha’ report on chronic disease in children
Read more
Two supposed studies on ADHD medication advertising simply do not exist in the journals where they are claimed to be published. Virginia Commonwealth University confirmed to Notus that researcher Robert L Findling, listed as an author of one paper, never wrote such an article, while another citation leads only to the Kennedy report itself when searched online.
Harold J Farber, a pediatric specialist supposedly behind research on asthma overprescribing, told Notus he never wrote the cited paper and had never worked with the other listed authors.
The US Department of
Health
and Human Services has not immediately responded to a Guardian request for comment.
The citation failures come as Kennedy, a noted skeptic of vaccines,
criticized medical publishing
this week, branding top journals the Lancet, New England Journal of Medicine and Jama as “corrupt” and alleging they were controlled by pharmaceutical companies. He outlined plans for creating government-run journals instead.
Beyond the phantom studies in Kennedy’s report, Notus found it systematically misrepresented existing research.
RFK’s health report omits key facts in painting dark vision for US children
Read more
For example, one paper was claimed to show that talking therapy was as effective as psychiatric medication, but the statistician Joanne McKenzie said this was impossible, as “we did not include psychotherapy” in the review.
The sleep researcher Mariana G Figueiro also said her study was mischaracterized, with the report incorrectly stating it involved children rather than college students, and citing the wrong journal entirely.
The
Trump administration
asked Kennedy for the report in order to look at chronic illness causes, from pesticides to mobile phone radiation. Kennedy called it a “milestone” that provides “evidence-based foundation” for sweeping policy changes.
A follow-up “Make our children healthy again strategy” report is due in August, raising concerns about the scientific credibility underpinning the administration’s health agenda.

• **justacrow** 以讽刺的方式建议 OpenAI 投资一个专门生成引用的服务 (Citations-as-a-Service)，以解决 AI 生成内容缺乏可靠来源的问题。

• **andy_ppp** 表达了对社会规范被侵蚀的担忧，认为社会已经从寻找改变观点的想法转向寻找证实自己怀疑的事实，并担心一个没有 truth 的社会注定会失败。

• **max_** 直言大型语言模型 (LLMs) 是净负面影响，提到在 Value Investors Club 中因为太多人提交 AI 生成的低质量分析，股票分析提交已被暂停。

• **sandworm101** 以幽默方式询问关于吃未煮熟熊肉导致的寄生虫影响的问题，属于偏离主要讨论的旁注。

• **nssnsjsjsjs** 指出 Maha 也是一个阿拉伯名字，与主要讨论主题无关。

• **comrade1234** 以讽刺语气询问“dupe”在重复三或四次情况下的表达方式，也是对讨论主题的旁注。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是政府政策与企业利益之间的关系，以及这些政策是否基于证据。**roenxi** 对缺乏证据的极端政策表示不满，并指出企业从这些政策中获益。

• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是对 AI 生成内容可靠性的质疑。**justacrow** 提出的讽刺建议和 **max_** 提到的实际案例（Value Investors Club 中的 AI 生成内容问题）都指向了这一问题。

• **andy_ppp** 的评论引发了对社会 truth 侵蚀的深层次担忧，强调了寻找事实和证实怀疑之间的冲突，以及这种冲突对社会的潜在影响。

Curie: A Research Experimentation Agent
Curie is the first AI-agent framework designed for automated and rigorous scientific experimentation.
Curie helps answer your curiosity through end-to-end experimentation automation, ensuring that every step—from hypothesis formulation to result interpretation—is conducted with precision, reliability, and reproducibility.
Our mission is to empower scientists to move research at the speed of thought.
Key Features
🚀 Automated Experimentation – From hypothesis formulation, experiment implementation, experiment execution, result analysis and finding reflection.
📊 Rigor Enhancement - Built-in verification modules enforce methodical procedure, agent reliability and reproducibility.
🔬 Broad Applicability – Supports ML research, system analysis, and scientific discovery.

data.title: Superauthenticity: Computer Game Aspect Ratios
data.author: msephton
data.article_summary:
文章主要讨论了早期电子游戏中的像素并非总是方形，而是具有不同的长宽比，直到1996年左右，许多电脑游戏才开始采用方形像素，而游戏机则更晚。由于旧设备和现代显示器的像素比例不同，将老游戏移植到现代设备上会遇到兼容性问题。文章还提到，过去的电视有“过扫描”（图像超出屏幕）和“欠扫描”（图像小于屏幕）现象，导致输出的画面不一定都是4:3比例。

为解决这些问题，文章提出几种方法，如直接渲染方形像素以避免失真，或通过数学计算近似还原原始像素比例。对于实际游戏体验，可以使用不同的缩放技术来改善显示效果。文章强调了在追求“真实性”时，适当调整和控制这些细节的重要性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：复古游戏图像的像素宽高比（PAR）和显示宽高比（DAR）的正确计算方法，以及如何呈现游戏的原始视觉效果。

不同观点：
• **ack_complete的观点**：主张从像素时钟和视频时序入手确定像素宽高比，再推导出显示宽高比。他认为基于图像区域估算宽高比是错误的，因为游戏往往偏离操作系统的标准分辨率（如Atari 8-bit的320x192）。此外，原始图像中的形状未必是正方形，因为分辨率有限，艺术家只能接近而不能完美呈现。他强调，对于支持NTSC色彩的系统（如Apple II和Atari），像素宽高比应相似。
  
• **Firehawke的观点**：认为应考虑艺术家的设计意图，游戏中的图形未必遵循统一的宽高比。例如，某些游戏中混合了不同的宽高比（如Chrono Trigger），且大多数玩家不会为每个游戏调整电视设置。虽然他反对将4:3的图像拉伸至16:9，但认为具体到每个游戏选择宽高比的做法也未必正确，因为不同系统和显示设备的差异较大。

• **egypturnash的观点**：通过具体游戏（Gridrunner）的例子说明网格单元应为正方形，并提到Jeff Minter的游戏重制版中非正方形像素的呈现方式。这表明在一些重制版中，像素宽高比可能被改变。

• **Firehawke补充的观点**：提到如TRS-80 Color Computer等系统有较大的过扫描区域，不同显示设备和设置会影响可见图像区域，因此确定正确的显示宽高比非常困难。

• **msephton的观点**：以Bruce Lee游戏为例，认为复古游戏的视觉效果像是一种可玩的立体模型。并通过Macintosh显示器的例子，说明推荐的活动区域宽高比接近1.5:1。

• **mkesper的观点**：强调正方形像素应符合艺术家的原始意图，并以具体游戏元素（如定居者的马车、月亮等）为例，认为CRT显示上的某些图像效果不佳。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户提到在移动设备浏览器上查看图像时，图像会被压缩变形，影响对宽高比的判断（如nottorp、shmeeed）。
• 用户kookamamie简短提及古代系统的宽高比问题，但未展开详细讨论。

争议焦点：
• 计算复古游戏宽高比的正确方法：是从像素时钟和视频时序入手，还是基于艺术家的设计意图或玩家的显示设备调整。
• 游戏图像是否应严格遵循4:3的显示宽高比，或是否应根据具体游戏和系统调整。

总结：讨论主要围绕复古游戏的像素宽高比和显示宽高比展开，涉及技术计算方法与艺术设计意图的平衡，以及不同设备和系统间的差异如何影响图像呈现。

44105531.article_content:
C64 pixel art demo by 8-Bit Guy: "
How 'oldschool' graphics worked Part 1
"
Pixels weren't always square, not even to the extent that you can say
pixels were rectangular
. Pixels could be fat, pixels could be thin, but it wasn't until about 1996 that many major computer games began to adopt the modern convention of square pixels, and not until 1998 that all of them did. For consoles, it took much longer, with the PS2, original Xbox, and even early non-HDMI models of the Xbox 360 employing an anamorphic fat-pixel format to produce a widescreen image in the games that supported this. Even to this day, the venerable DVD format sees some consumer use and uses nonsquare pixels for both 4:3 and widescreen videos.
This poses a nontrivial problem for modern compatibility, albeit one that's been solved in myriad ways. That SNES game with pixels that are 1.14 times wider than they are tall doesn't translate easily to a modern square pixel display! Even in the early days of emulation, when CRT monitors were common and capable of rectangular pixels, they did not necessarily support the modes that matched the original system's pixel aspect ratio.
Another convention we take for granted today is that the source image dimensions will match the screen's. Televisions and monitors in the 80's and 90's had a 4:3 aspect ratio, and it's typically assumed that any game's output format will match this - even emulators usually assume this. This is a somewhat faulty assumption; the final picture could wind up being larger than the television screen, leading to pixels being cut off at the edges. This is known as overscan. Or perhaps the final picture is
smaller
than the screen, and uses only a portion of the real estate. This is known as underscan. Overscan tended to be more common with consoles, underscan more common with computers, but either way, it's possible for the final picture to have an aspect ratio other than 4:3, and it's erroneous to assume that every game "targets" 4:3.
Actually, this helps illustrate the distinction between my authenticity and superauthenticity concepts. A more authentic experience would preserve overscan/underscan on systems that had them, but anyone playing on a modern display probably doesn't want this, and in situations where we do, it's better that we are able to control it precisely, which was not possible on most consumer televisions.
Regarding pixel aspect ratio, the simplest solution is to simply render your pixels as squares. The picture dimensions will be distorted, but you completely avoid introducing any kind of detail loss or artifact introduction. For blogging purposes, this is what I typically do - just as I consider pixel shaders to be inappropriate for documentation purposes, so is image scaling and/or preprocessing. I consider it a failing on the part of digital imaging technology that no widely supported image format even has an option for non-square pixels.
Square pixels
Thin pixels, nearest-neighbor scaling
Thin pixels, linear scaling
Thin pixels, cubic scaling
For actually playing the game, though, we have more options. Thumbnail-size screenshots are fine for blogging, but when I play games, I like my playfields nice and big. Modern displays might be limited to square pixels, but modern displays have a lot of them. With a bit of math, we can approximate the correct pixel aspect ratio by scaling the image integrally but unequally. In this case, 300% on the horizontal and 400% on the vertical does a decent job of getting us large, thin pixels and a pleasing end result, and "only" needs a display of 912x800 to work losslessly.
If you want it bigger than that, bicubic scaling is your friend and will get you whatever output resolution you want without compromising those pixels. This two-step approach is how I make my videos when the emulator allows it; record raw, scale to approximate aspect ratio, and bicubic scale the rest of the way.
1440p; click to enlarge
With CRT shaders, or even just using bicubic filtering all the way, we aren't even trying to render the original pixels as rectangles, and aspect ratios can be scaled arbitrarily in one step without needing to worry about integral scaling. It is no problem for crt-royale to scale a 320x200 source image to a 1440x1080 one (450% horizontal and 540% vertical), but the bigger your output resolution, the better your results will be.
crt-royale
Bicubic
These days, most emulators presume a 4:3 display aspect ratio, which generally gives you a close enough pixel aspect ratio, and default scaling generally looks good enough. A casual user doesn't really need to worry too much about it, but I feel there's value in giving it some thought. Authenticity demands that pixel aspect ratio be approximate to the originals - not necessarily
exact
, as exact isn't a thing in an analog television world. But superauthenticity allows that sometimes things can be even better than the originals if we don't do that. Often, the artists were working with squ

• **Firehawke补充的观点**：提到如TRS-80 Color Computer等系统有较大的过扫描区域，不同显示设备和设置会影响可见图像区域，因此确定正确的显示宽高比非常困难。

• **msephton的观点**：以Bruce Lee游戏为例，认为复古游戏的视觉效果像是一种可玩的立体模型。并通过Macintosh显示器的例子，说明推荐的活动区域宽高比接近1.5:1。

• **mkesper的观点**：强调正方形像素应符合艺术家的原始意图，并以具体游戏元素（如定居者的马车、月亮等）为例，认为CRT显示上的某些图像效果不佳。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户提到在移动设备浏览器上查看图像时，图像会被压缩变形，影响对宽高比的判断（如nottorp、shmeeed）。
• 用户kookamamie简短提及古代系统的宽高比问题，但未展开详细讨论。

争议焦点：
• 计算复古游戏宽高比的正确方法：是从像素时钟和视频时序入手，还是基于艺术家的设计意图或玩家的显示设备调整。
• 游戏图像是否应严格遵循4:3的显示宽高比，或是否应根据具体游戏和系统调整。

总结：讨论主要围绕复古游戏的像素宽高比和显示宽高比展开，涉及技术计算方法与艺术设计意图的平衡，以及不同设备和系统间的差异如何影响图像呈现。

44132409.article_content:
MILPITAS, Calif. AND DUBLIN –
May 27, 2025
–
MariaDB plc
today announced the acquisition of Finnish-based company Codership Oy and its flagship product Galera Cluster, a powerful high availability database solution providing high uptime, no data loss and scalability for database growth. With the acquisition, the core Galera team, as well as its founders, will join MariaDB, strengthening the company’s European engineering and technical support team.
Since its inception nearly 14 years ago, Galera Cluster has prioritized its relationship with MariaDB, including through partnerships and technical integration. It has been a standard part of MariaDB Server for over nine years. Over a third of
MariaDB Enterprise Platform
customers utilize
Galera Cluster
today. As the demand for high availability and zero data loss in high-volume production environments grows, the combination of MariaDB Enterprise Platform and Galera Cluster is gaining significant traction within MariaDB’s customer-base.
“High availability and advanced replication methods are a critical area for our enterprise customers,” said Vikas Mathur, chief product officer, MariaDB plc. “When I speak to our customers, it is clear that these values have always been a strength of MariaDB. By bringing Galera Cluster into the fold formally, we’ll be able to take MariaDB’s high availability and advanced replication power to the next level, as well as deliver an even higher level of support and service to our customers.”
“The acquisition of Galera Cluster marks an exciting step in MariaDB’s growth journey,” said Rohit de Souza, CEO, MariaDB plc. “In a very short period of time, we’ve delivered significant product innovation both to our customers and to our community, while also turning the company into a well-run and profitable business. This acquisition will enable us to accelerate our pace of innovation so we can deliver exceptional value to our customers at an even faster rate.”
“Joining MariaDB is an exciting step for Codership and Galera Cluster,” said Seppo Jaakola, co-founder of Codership, the company behind Galera Cluster. “We know MariaDB users greatly benefit from our high availability solution, and this acquisition will expand our reach, bringing our clustering technology to even more customers.”
Galera Cluster works with both MariaDB and MySQL database environments. Both versions will be maintained for the time being and users should experience no change. Please
contact MariaDB
if you are interested in upgrading from community to the enterprise version of MariaDB.
Since last September’s
take-private transaction by K1 Investment Management
and appointment of Rohit de Souza as MariaDB’s CEO, MariaDB has invested heavily in innovation for its database customers and users, including launching open source vector search capabilities, a new MariaDB Enterprise Platform version with advanced enterprise tooling and now acquisition of Galera Cluster synchronous replication technology to further bolster its Enterprise Platform capabilities. MariaDB was also recognized as a
winner of a 2025 AI TechAward
in the category of Open Source AI for its innovation in open source vector search capabilities.
To learn about the advantages of Galera Cluster’s synchronous replication and built-in high availability features, watch MariaDB’s recent webinar “
High Availability with MariaDB: Choosing the Right Approach – Clustering vs Replication
.”

data.title: The ELF: What the ARM Assembler Generates on Raspberry Pi
data.author: Teever
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了在Raspberry Pi上运行ARM汇编程序时，汇编器生成的二进制对象文件的结构和内容。通过手动解析ELF格式和检查对象文件的十六进制转储，作者详细解释了ELF文件的组成。ELF（可执行与链接格式）文件包含ELF头、节头表和各个节等结构。本文还提到ELF规范是更广泛的应用二进制接口（ABI）规范的一部分，该规范定义了构建应用程序执行环境所需的接口。具体来说，System V ABI的第4章“对象文件”对解析ELF文件非常重要。通过分析，文章展示了汇编器生成的二进制文件如何遵循这些标准和结构。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：设计原则的适用对象

不同观点：
• 观点一：设计原则适用于操作系统本身，而不是用户界面。[reconnecting]认为设计原则是针对操作系统本身的，而不是仅仅局限于用户界面。这表明设计原则应该影响整个操作系统的结构和功能，而不仅仅是用户交互部分。
• 观点二：设计原则通常被认为与用户界面相关。隐含的观点是，许多人可能通常会把设计原则主要与用户界面（UI）设计联系在一起，包括用户体验（UX）和交互设计等方面。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于设计原则的适用范围。一部分人认为这些原则应广泛应用于整个操作系统，而另一些人可能更倾向于认为它们主要涉及用户界面设计。
• 例子和论据：[reconnecting]提到这一点是为了澄清设计原则的实际适用对象，以避免误解。这表明在讨论设计原则时，明确其具体指向（操作系统或用户界面）非常重要，以便更准确地理解和应用这些原则。

总结：讨论的核心在于设计原则是针对操作系统整体还是仅限于用户界面，这涉及到对设计原则应用范围的不同理解。
